# Authentication

* API Key (secretKey)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. API key authentication. Allowed headers-- "Authorization: ApiKey <novu_secret_key>".

<h1 id="novu-api-events">Events</h1>

Events represent a change in state of a subscriber. They are used to trigger workflows, and enable you to send notifications to subscribers based on their actions.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/workflows">External documentation</a>

## Trigger event

<a id="opIdEventsController_trigger"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/events/trigger \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "workflow_identifier",
    "payload": {
      "comment_id": "string",
      "post": {
        "text": "string"
      }
    },
    "bridgeUrl": "https://your-tunnel.novu.co/api/novu",
    "overrides": {
      "fcm": {
        "data": {
          "key": "value"
        }
      }
    },
    "agentId": "support-agent",
    "to": [
      {
        "firstName": "John",
        "lastName": "Doe",
        "email": "john.doe@example.com",
        "phone": "+1234567890",
        "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
        "locale": "en-US",
        "timezone": "America/New_York",
        "data": {},
        "subscriberId": "string",
        "channels": [
          {
            "providerId": "slack",
            "integrationIdentifier": "string",
            "credentials": {
              "webhookUrl": "string",
              "deviceTokens": [
                "string"
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "transactionId": "string",
    "actor": "string",
    "tenant": "string",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/events/trigger`


    Trigger event is the main (and only) way to send notifications to subscribers. The trigger identifier is used to match the particular workflow associated with it. Maximum number of recipients can be 100. Additional information can be passed according the body interface below.
    To prevent duplicate triggers, you can optionally pass a **transactionId** in the request body. If the same **transactionId** is used again, the trigger will be ignored. The retention period depends on your billing tier.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "workflow_identifier",
  "payload": {
    "comment_id": "string",
    "post": {
      "text": "string"
    }
  },
  "bridgeUrl": "https://your-tunnel.novu.co/api/novu",
  "overrides": {
    "fcm": {
      "data": {
        "key": "value"
      }
    }
  },
  "agentId": "support-agent",
  "to": [
    {
      "firstName": "John",
      "lastName": "Doe",
      "email": "john.doe@example.com",
      "phone": "+1234567890",
      "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
      "locale": "en-US",
      "timezone": "America/New_York",
      "data": {},
      "subscriberId": "string",
      "channels": [
        {
          "providerId": "slack",
          "integrationIdentifier": "string",
          "credentials": {
            "webhookUrl": "string",
            "deviceTokens": [
              "string"
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "transactionId": "string",
  "actor": "string",
  "tenant": "string",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="trigger-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[TriggerEventRequestDto](#schematriggereventrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The trigger identifier of the workflow you wish to send. This identifier can be found on the workflow page.|
|» payload|body|object|false|The payload object is used to pass additional custom information that could be <br>    used to render the workflow, or perform routing rules based on it. <br>      This data will also be available when fetching the notifications feed from the API to display certain parts of the UI.|
|» bridgeUrl|body|string|false|Optional Bridge Endpoint URL used to route this trigger to a specific Bridge application. Useful during local development when multiple engineers share an organization: set this to your personal tunnel URL from `npx novu@latest dev` (for example via NOVU_BRIDGE_URL) so app-fired triggers hit your machine instead of the environment's synced Bridge URL. Must be a publicly reachable https URL — private or localhost addresses are rejected.|
|» overrides|body|object|false|This could be used to override provider specific configurations|
|» » steps|body|object|false|This could be used to override provider specific configurations or layout at the step level|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|[StepsOverrides](#schemastepsoverrides)|false|none|
|» » channels|body|object|false|Channel-specific overrides that apply to all steps of a particular channel type. Step-level overrides take precedence over channel-level overrides.|
|» » » email|body|object|false|Email channel specific overrides|
|» » » » layoutId|body|string \| null|false|Override or remove the layout for all email steps in the workflow|
|» » providers|body|object|false|Overrides the provider configuration for the entire workflow and all steps|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» » email|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the email provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » push|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the push provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » sms|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the sms provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » chat|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the chat provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » layoutIdentifier|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** Override the layout identifier for the entire workflow|
|» » severity|body|object|false|Override the severity of the workflow|
|» agentId|body|string \| null|false|Override the workflow-assigned agent for this trigger using the public agent identifier. Omit to use the workflow default; pass null to disable agent routing for this execution.|
|» to|body|[[SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto) \| [TopicPayloadDto](#schematopicpayloaddto) \| string] \| string \| [SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto) \| [TopicPayloadDto](#schematopicpayloaddto)|true|The recipients list of people who will receive the notification. Maximum number of recipients can be 100.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[[SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto) \| [TopicPayloadDto](#schematopicpayloaddto) \| string]|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[TopicPayloadDto](#schematopicpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|string|false|Unique identifier of a subscriber in your systems|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Unique identifier of a subscriber in your systems|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[TopicPayloadDto](#schematopicpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» transactionId|body|string|false|A unique identifier for deduplication. If the same **transactionId** is sent again, <br>      the trigger is ignored. Useful to prevent duplicate notifications. The retention period depends on your billing tier.|
|» actor|body|string \| [SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto)|false|It is used to display the Avatar of the provided actor's subscriber id or actor object.<br>    If a new actor object is provided, we will create a new subscriber in our system|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Unique identifier of a subscriber in your systems|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» tenant|body|string \| [TenantPayloadDto](#schematenantpayloaddto)|false|It is used to specify a tenant context during trigger event.<br>    Existing tenants will be updated with the provided details.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Unique identifier of a tenant in your system|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[TenantPayloadDto](#schematenantpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|

```json
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Payload validation failed - returned when payload does not match the workflow schema|[PayloadValidationExceptionDto](#schemapayloadvalidationexceptiondto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method Not Allowed|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|409|Conflict|Conflict|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|413|Payload Too Large|Payload Too Large|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|414|URI Too Long|URI Too Long|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Unsupported Media Type|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable Entity|[ValidationErrorDto](#schemavalidationerrordto)|
|429|Too Many Requests|The client has sent too many requests in a given amount of time. |Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|Inline|

## Bulk trigger event

<a id="opIdEventsController_triggerBulk"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/events/trigger/bulk \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "events": [
      {
        "name": "workflow_identifier",
        "payload": {
          "comment_id": "string",
          "post": {
            "text": "string"
          }
        },
        "bridgeUrl": "https://your-tunnel.novu.co/api/novu",
        "overrides": {
          "fcm": {
            "data": {
              "key": "value"
            }
          }
        },
        "agentId": "support-agent",
        "to": [
          {
            "firstName": "John",
            "lastName": "Doe",
            "email": "john.doe@example.com",
            "phone": "+1234567890",
            "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
            "locale": "en-US",
            "timezone": "America/New_York",
            "data": {},
            "subscriberId": "string",
            "channels": [
              {
```

`POST /v1/events/trigger/bulk`


      Using this endpoint you can trigger multiple events at once, to avoid multiple calls to the API.
      The bulk API is limited to 100 events per request.
    

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "events": [
    {
      "name": "workflow_identifier",
      "payload": {
        "comment_id": "string",
        "post": {
          "text": "string"
        }
      },
      "bridgeUrl": "https://your-tunnel.novu.co/api/novu",
      "overrides": {
        "fcm": {
          "data": {
            "key": "value"
          }
        }
      },
      "agentId": "support-agent",
      "to": [
        {
          "firstName": "John",
          "lastName": "Doe",
          "email": "john.doe@example.com",
          "phone": "+1234567890",
          "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
          "locale": "en-US",
          "timezone": "America/New_York",
          "data": {},
          "subscriberId": "string",
          "channels": [
            {
              "providerId": "slack",
              "integrationIdentifier": "string",
              "credentials": {
                "webhookUrl": "string",
                "deviceTokens": [
                  "string"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "transactionId": "string",
      "actor": "string",
      "tenant": "string",
      "context": {
        "property1": "org-acme",
        "property2": "org-acme"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Broadcast event to all

<a id="opIdEventsController_broadcastEventToAll"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/events/trigger/broadcast \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "payload": {
      "comment_id": "string",
      "post": {
        "text": "string"
      }
    },
    "overrides": {
      "fcm": {
        "data": {
          "key": "value"
        }
      }
    },
    "agentId": "support-agent",
    "transactionId": "string",
    "actor": "string",
    "tenant": "string",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/events/trigger/broadcast`

Trigger a broadcast event to all existing subscribers, could be used to send announcements, etc.
      In the future could be used to trigger events to a subset of subscribers based on defined filters.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "payload": {
    "comment_id": "string",
    "post": {
      "text": "string"
    }
  },
  "overrides": {
    "fcm": {
      "data": {
        "key": "value"
      }
    }
  },
  "agentId": "support-agent",
  "transactionId": "string",
  "actor": "string",
  "tenant": "string",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="broadcast-event-to-all-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[TriggerEventToAllRequestDto](#schematriggereventtoallrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The trigger identifier associated for the template you wish to send. This identifier can be found on the template page.|
|» payload|body|object|true|The payload object is used to pass additional information that <br>    could be used to render the template, or perform routing rules based on it. <br>      For In-App channel, payload data are also available in <Inbox />|
|» overrides|body|object|false|This could be used to override provider specific configurations|
|» » steps|body|object|false|This could be used to override provider specific configurations or layout at the step level|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|[StepsOverrides](#schemastepsoverrides)|false|none|
|» » channels|body|object|false|Channel-specific overrides that apply to all steps of a particular channel type. Step-level overrides take precedence over channel-level overrides.|
|» » » email|body|object|false|Email channel specific overrides|
|» » » » layoutId|body|string \| null|false|Override or remove the layout for all email steps in the workflow|
|» » providers|body|object|false|Overrides the provider configuration for the entire workflow and all steps|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» » email|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the email provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » push|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the push provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » sms|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the sms provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » chat|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Override the chat provider specific configurations for the entire workflow|
|» » layoutIdentifier|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** Override the layout identifier for the entire workflow|
|» » severity|body|object|false|Override the severity of the workflow|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» agentId|body|string \| null|false|Override the workflow-assigned agent for this trigger using the public agent identifier. Omit to use the workflow default; pass null to disable agent routing for this execution.|
|» transactionId|body|string|false|A unique identifier for this transaction, we will generated a UUID if not provided.|
|» actor|body|string \| [SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto)|false|It is used to display the Avatar of the provided actor's subscriber id or actor object.<br>    If a new actor object is provided, we will create a new subscriber in our system<br>    |
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Unique identifier of a subscriber in your systems|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» tenant|body|string \| [TenantPayloadDto](#schematenantpayloaddto)|false|It is used to specify a tenant context during trigger event.<br>    If a new tenant object is provided, we will create a new tenant.<br>    |
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Unique identifier of a tenant in your system|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[TenantPayloadDto](#schematenantpayloaddto)|false|none|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|

## Cancel triggered event

<a id="opIdEventsController_cancel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/events/trigger/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/events/trigger/{transactionId}`


    Using a previously generated transactionId during the event trigger,
     will cancel any active or pending workflows. This is useful to cancel active digests, delays etc...
    

<h3 id="cancel-triggered-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transactionId|path|string|true|none|

```json
true
```

<h1 id="novu-api-subscribers">Subscribers</h1>

A subscriber in Novu represents someone who should receive a message. A subscriber's profile information contains important attributes about the subscriber that will be used in messages (name, email). The subscriber object can contain other key-value pairs that can be used to further personalize your messages.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/subscribers/subscribers">External documentation</a>

## Bulk create subscribers

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_bulkCreateSubscribers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/bulk \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "subscribers": [
      {
        "firstName": "John",
        "lastName": "Doe",
        "email": "john.doe@example.com",
        "phone": "+1234567890",
        "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
        "locale": "en-US",
        "timezone": "America/New_York",
        "data": {},
        "subscriberId": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v1/subscribers/bulk`


      Using this endpoint multiple subscribers can be created at once. The bulk API is limited to 500 subscribers per request.
    

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscribers": [
    {
      "firstName": "John",
      "lastName": "Doe",
      "email": "john.doe@example.com",
      "phone": "+1234567890",
      "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
      "locale": "en-US",
      "timezone": "America/New_York",
      "data": {},
      "subscriberId": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

|body|body|[BulkSubscriberCreateDto](#schemabulksubscribercreatedto)|true|none|
|» subscribers|body|[[CreateSubscriberRequestDto](#schemacreatesubscriberrequestdto)]|true|An array of subscribers to be created in bulk.|

## Update provider credentials

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_updateSubscriberChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/credentials \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "providerId": {},
    "integrationIdentifier": "string",
    "credentials": {
      "webhookUrl": "https://example.com/webhook",
      "channel": "general",
      "deviceTokens": [
        "token1",
        "token2",
        "token3"
      ],
      "alertUid": "12345-abcde",
      "title": "Critical Alert",
      "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.png",
      "state": "resolved",
      "externalUrl": "https://example.com/details"
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/credentials`

Update credentials for a provider such as **slack** and **FCM**. 
      **providerId** is required field. This API creates the **deviceTokens** or replaces the existing ones.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "providerId": {},
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "credentials": {
    "webhookUrl": "https://example.com/webhook",
    "channel": "general",
    "deviceTokens": [
      "token1",
      "token2",
      "token3"
    ],
    "alertUid": "12345-abcde",
    "title": "Critical Alert",
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.png",
    "state": "resolved",
    "externalUrl": "https://example.com/details"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-provider-credentials-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateSubscriberChannelRequestDto](#schemaupdatesubscriberchannelrequestdto)|true|none|
|» providerId|body|object|true|The provider identifier for the credentials|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|false|The integration identifier|
|» credentials|body|object|true|Credentials payload for the specified provider|
|» » webhookUrl|body|string|false|Webhook URL used by chat app integrations. The webhook should be obtained from the chat app provider.|
|» » channel|body|string|false|Channel specification for Mattermost chat notifications.|
|» » deviceTokens|body|[string]|false|Contains an array of the subscriber device tokens for a given provider. Used on Push integrations.|
|» » alertUid|body|string|false|Alert UID for Grafana on-call webhook payload.|
|» » title|body|string|false|Title to be used with Grafana on-call webhook.|
|» » imageUrl|body|string|false|Image URL property for Grafana on-call webhook.|
|» » state|body|string|false|State property for Grafana on-call webhook.|
|» » externalUrl|body|string|false|Link to upstream details property for Grafana on-call webhook.|

## Upsert provider credentials

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_modifySubscriberChannel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/credentials \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "providerId": {},
    "integrationIdentifier": "string",
    "credentials": {
      "webhookUrl": "https://example.com/webhook",
      "channel": "general",
      "deviceTokens": [
        "token1",
        "token2",
        "token3"
      ],
      "alertUid": "12345-abcde",
      "title": "Critical Alert",
      "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.png",
      "state": "resolved",
      "externalUrl": "https://example.com/details"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/credentials`

Upsert credentials for a provider such as **slack** and **FCM**. 
      **providerId** is required field. This API creates **deviceTokens** or appends to the existing ones.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "providerId": {},
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "credentials": {
    "webhookUrl": "https://example.com/webhook",
    "channel": "general",
    "deviceTokens": [
      "token1",
      "token2",
      "token3"
    ],
    "alertUid": "12345-abcde",
    "title": "Critical Alert",
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.png",
    "state": "resolved",
    "externalUrl": "https://example.com/details"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="upsert-provider-credentials-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateSubscriberChannelRequestDto](#schemaupdatesubscriberchannelrequestdto)|true|none|
|» providerId|body|object|true|The provider identifier for the credentials|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|false|The integration identifier|
|» credentials|body|object|true|Credentials payload for the specified provider|
|» » webhookUrl|body|string|false|Webhook URL used by chat app integrations. The webhook should be obtained from the chat app provider.|
|» » channel|body|string|false|Channel specification for Mattermost chat notifications.|
|» » deviceTokens|body|[string]|false|Contains an array of the subscriber device tokens for a given provider. Used on Push integrations.|
|» » alertUid|body|string|false|Alert UID for Grafana on-call webhook payload.|
|» » title|body|string|false|Title to be used with Grafana on-call webhook.|
|» » imageUrl|body|string|false|Image URL property for Grafana on-call webhook.|
|» » state|body|string|false|State property for Grafana on-call webhook.|
|» » externalUrl|body|string|false|Link to upstream details property for Grafana on-call webhook.|

## Delete provider credentials

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_deleteSubscriberCredentials"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/credentials/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/credentials/{providerId}`

Delete subscriber credentials for a provider such as **slack** and **FCM** by **providerId**. 
    This action is irreversible and will remove the credentials for the provider for particular **subscriberId**.

<h3 id="delete-provider-credentials-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|providerId|path|string|true|none|

## Update subscriber online status

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_updateSubscriberOnlineFlag"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/online-status \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "isOnline": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/online-status`

Update the subscriber online status by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "isOnline": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-subscriber-online-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateSubscriberOnlineFlagRequestDto](#schemaupdatesubscriberonlineflagrequestdto)|true|none|
|» isOnline|body|boolean|true|none|

## Retrieve subscriber notifications

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_getNotificationsFeed"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/notifications/feed \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/feed`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

This API is deprecated, use v2 API instead. Retrieve subscriber in-app notifications by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|page|query|number|false|none|
|limit|query|number|false|none|
|feedIdentifier|query|[string]|false|none|
|read|query|boolean|false|none|
|seen|query|boolean|false|none|
|payload|query|string|false|Base64 encoded string of the partial payload JSON object|

## Retrieve unseen notifications count

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_getUnseenCount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/notifications/unseen \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/unseen`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

This API is deprecated, use v2 API instead. Retrieve unseen in-app notifications count for a subscriber by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**.

<h3 id="retrieve-unseen-notifications-count-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|feedId|query|[string]|false|Identifier for the feed. Can be a single string or an array of strings.|
|seen|query|boolean|false|Indicates whether to count seen notifications.|
|limit|query|number|false|The maximum number of notifications to return.|

## Update notifications state

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_markMessagesAs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/messages/mark-as \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "messageId": "string",
    "markAs": "read"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/messages/mark-as`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

This API is deprecated, use v2 API instead. Update subscriber's multiple in-app notifications state such as seen, read, unseen or unread by **subscriberId**. 
      **messageId** is of type mongodbId of notifications.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "messageId": "string",
  "markAs": "read"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[MessageMarkAsRequestDto](#schemamessagemarkasrequestdto)|true|none|
|» messageId|body|string \| [string]|true|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» markAs|body|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» markAs|read|
|» markAs|seen|
|» markAs|unread|
|» markAs|unseen|

## Update all notifications state

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_markAllUnreadAsRead"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/messages/mark-all \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "feedIdentifier": "string",
    "markAs": "read"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/messages/mark-all`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

This API is deprecated, use v2 API instead. Update all subscriber in-app notifications state such as read, unread, seen or unseen by **subscriberId**.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "feedIdentifier": "string",
  "markAs": "read"
}
```

|» » *oneOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» markAs|body|string|true|Mark all subscriber messages as read, unread, seen or unseen|

## Update notification action status

<a id="opIdSubscribersV1Controller_markActionAsSeen"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/subscribers/string/messages/string/actions/primary \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "status": "pending",
    "payload": {}
  }'
```

`POST /v1/subscribers/{subscriberId}/messages/{messageId}/actions/{type}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

This API is deprecated, use v2 API instead. Update in-app notification's action status by its unique key identifier **messageId** and type field **type**. 
      **type** field can be **primary** or **secondary**

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "status": "pending",
  "payload": {}
}
```

<h3 id="update-notification-action-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|messageId|path|string|true|none|
|type|path|string|true|none|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[MarkMessageActionAsSeenDto](#schemamarkmessageactionasseendto)|true|none|
|» status|body|string|true|Message action status|
|» payload|body|object|false|Message action payload|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|primary|
|type|secondary|
|» status|pending|
|» status|done|

## Search subscribers

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_searchSubscribers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/subscribers`

Search subscribers by their **email**, **phone**, **subscriberId** and **name**. 
    The search is case sensitive and supports pagination.Checkout all available filters in the query section.

<h3 id="search-subscribers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|email|query|string|false|Exact email address of the subscriber. The value must match the stored email field.|
|name|query|string|false|Name of the subscriber to filter results.|
|phone|query|string|false|Exact phone number of the subscriber. The value must match the stored phone field.|
|subscriberId|query|string|false|Unique identifier of the subscriber to filter results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create a subscriber

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_createSubscriber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com",
    "phone": "+1234567890",
    "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
    "locale": "en-US",
    "timezone": "America/New_York",
    "data": {},
    "subscriberId": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/subscribers`

Create a subscriber with the subscriber attributes. 
      **subscriberId** is a required field, rest other fields are optional, if the subscriber already exists, it will be updated

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "email": "john.doe@example.com",
  "phone": "+1234567890",
  "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
  "locale": "en-US",
  "timezone": "America/New_York",
  "data": {},
  "subscriberId": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-subscriber-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|failIfExists|query|boolean|false|If true, the request will fail if a subscriber with the same subscriberId already exists|
|body|body|[CreateSubscriberRequestDto](#schemacreatesubscriberrequestdto)|true|none|
|» firstName|body|string \| null|false|First name of the subscriber|
|» lastName|body|string \| null|false|Last name of the subscriber|
|» email|body|string(email) \| null|false|Email address of the subscriber|
|» phone|body|string \| null|false|Phone number of the subscriber|
|» avatar|body|string \| null|false|Avatar URL or identifier|
|» locale|body|string \| null|false|Locale of the subscriber|
|» timezone|body|string \| null|false|Timezone of the subscriber|
|» data|body|object \| null|false|Additional custom data associated with the subscriber|
|» subscriberId|body|string|true|Unique identifier of the subscriber|

## Retrieve a subscriber

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_getSubscriber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}`

Retrieve a subscriber by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    **subscriberId** field is required.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-subscriber-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|

## Delete a subscriber

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_removeSubscriber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}`

Deletes a subscriber entity from the Novu platform along with associated messages, preferences, and topic subscriptions. 
      **subscriberId** is a required field.

<h3 id="delete-a-subscriber-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|

## Update a subscriber

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_patchSubscriber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com",
    "phone": "+1234567890",
    "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
    "locale": "en-US",
    "timezone": "America/New_York",
    "data": {}
  }'
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}`

Update a subscriber by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    **subscriberId** is a required field, rest other fields are optional

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "email": "john.doe@example.com",
  "phone": "+1234567890",
  "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
  "locale": "en-US",
  "timezone": "America/New_York",
  "data": {}
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-subscriber-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|body|body|[PatchSubscriberRequestDto](#schemapatchsubscriberrequestdto)|true|none|
|» firstName|body|string \| null|false|First name of the subscriber|
|» lastName|body|string \| null|false|Last name of the subscriber|
|» email|body|string(email) \| null|false|Email address of the subscriber|
|» phone|body|string \| null|false|Phone number of the subscriber|
|» avatar|body|string \| null|false|Avatar URL or identifier|
|» locale|body|string \| null|false|Locale of the subscriber|
|» timezone|body|string \| null|false|Timezone of the subscriber|
|» data|body|object \| null|false|Additional custom data associated with the subscriber|

## Retrieve subscriber preferences

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_getSubscriberPreferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/preferences \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/preferences`

Retrieve subscriber channel preferences by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    This API returns all five channels preferences for all workflows and global preferences.

<h3 id="retrieve-subscriber-preferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|criticality|query|string|false|none|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering preferences (e.g., ["tenant:acme"])|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|criticality|critical|
|criticality|nonCritical|
|criticality|all|

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/preferences`

Update subscriber preferences by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    **workflowId** is optional field, if provided, this API will update that workflow preference, 
    otherwise it will update global preferences

## Bulk update subscriber preferences

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_bulkUpdateSubscriberPreferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/preferences/bulk \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "preferences": [
      {
        "channels": {
          "email": true,
          "sms": true,
          "in_app": true,
          "push": true,
          "chat": true,
          "tool": true
        },
        "workflowId": "string"
      }
    ],
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/preferences/bulk`

Bulk update subscriber preferences by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    This API allows updating multiple workflow preferences in a single request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "preferences": [
    {
      "channels": {
        "email": true,
        "sms": true,
        "in_app": true,
        "push": true,
        "chat": true,
        "tool": true
      },
      "workflowId": "string"
    }
  ],
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="bulk-update-subscriber-preferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|body|body|[BulkUpdateSubscriberPreferencesDto](#schemabulkupdatesubscriberpreferencesdto)|true|none|
|» preferences|body|[[BulkUpdateSubscriberPreferenceItemDto](#schemabulkupdatesubscriberpreferenceitemdto)]|true|Array of workflow preferences to update (maximum 100 items)|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|

## Retrieve subscriber subscriptions

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_listSubscriberTopics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/subscriptions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/subscriptions`

Retrieve subscriber's topic subscriptions by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    Checkout all available filters in the query section.

<h3 id="retrieve-subscriber-subscriptions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return (max 100)|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|key|query|string|false|Filter by topic key|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Filter by exact context keys, order insensitive (format: "type:id")|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Retrieve subscriber notifications

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_getSubscriberNotifications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications`

Retrieve in-app (inbox) notifications for a subscriber by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    Supports filtering by tags, read/archived/snoozed/seen state, data attributes, severity, date range, and context keys.

<h3 id="retrieve-subscriber-notifications-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|limit|query|number|false|none|
|after|query|string|false|none|
|offset|query|number|false|none|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Filter by workflow tags. Returns notifications that have any of the given tags.|
|read|query|boolean|false|Filter by read/unread state|
|archived|query|boolean|false|Filter by archived state|
|snoozed|query|boolean|false|Filter by snoozed state|
|seen|query|boolean|false|Filter by seen state|
|data|query|string|false|Filter by data attributes (JSON string)|
|severity|query|[string]|false|Filter by severity levels|
|createdGte|query|number|false|Filter notifications created on or after this timestamp (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)|
|createdLte|query|number|false|Filter notifications created on or before this timestamp (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering notifications in multi-context scenarios|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|severity|high|
|severity|medium|
|severity|low|
|severity|none|

## Retrieve subscriber notifications count

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_getSubscriberNotificationsCount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/count?filters=%5B%7B%22read%22%3Afalse%2C%22archived%22%3Afalse%7D%2C%7B%22tags%22%3A%5B%22important%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22tags%22%3A%7B%22and%22%3A%5B%7B%22or%22%3A%5B%22a%22%2C%22b%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22or%22%3A%5B%22c%22%5D%7D%5D%7D%7D%5D' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/count`

Retrieve count of in-app (inbox) notifications for a subscriber by its unique key identifier **subscriberId**. 
    Supports multiple filters to count in-app (inbox) notifications by different criteria, including context keys.

<h3 id="retrieve-subscriber-notifications-count-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|filters|query|string|true|Array of filter objects (max 30) to count notifications by different criteria|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "count": 0,
      "filter": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

## Mark a notification as read

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_markNotificationAsRead"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/string/read \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/{notificationId}/read`

Mark a specific in-app (inbox) notification as read by its unique identifier **notificationId**.

<h3 id="mark-a-notification-as-read-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|notificationId|path|string|true|The identifier of the notification|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering|

## Mark a notification as unread

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_markNotificationAsUnread"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/string/unread \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/{notificationId}/unread`

Mark a specific in-app (inbox) notification as unread by its unique identifier **notificationId**.

<h3 id="mark-a-notification-as-unread-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|notificationId|path|string|true|The identifier of the notification|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering|

## Snooze a notification

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_snoozeNotification"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/string/snooze \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "snoozeUntil": "2026-03-01T10:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/{notificationId}/snooze`

Snooze a specific in-app (inbox) notification by its unique identifier **notificationId** until a specified time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "snoozeUntil": "2026-03-01T10:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="snooze-a-notification-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|notificationId|path|string|true|The identifier of the notification|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering|
|body|body|[SnoozeSubscriberNotificationDto](#schemasnoozesubscribernotificationdto)|true|none|
|» snoozeUntil|body|string(date-time)|true|The date and time until which the notification should be snoozed|

## Unsnooze a notification

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_unsnoozeNotification"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/string/unsnooze \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/{notificationId}/unsnooze`

Unsnooze a specific in-app (inbox) notification by its unique identifier **notificationId**.

<h3 id="unsnooze-a-notification-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|

|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering|

## Complete a notification action

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_completeNotificationAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/string/actions/primary/complete \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/{notificationId}/actions/{actionType}/complete`

Mark a single in-app (inbox) notification's action (primary or secondary) as completed by its unique identifier **notificationId** and action type **actionType**.

<h3 id="complete-a-notification-action-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|notificationId|path|string|true|The identifier of the notification|
|actionType|path|string|true|The type of action (primary or secondary)|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|actionType|primary|
|actionType|secondary|

## Revert a notification action

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_revertNotificationAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/string/actions/primary/revert \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`PATCH /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/{notificationId}/actions/{actionType}/revert`

Revert a single in-app (inbox) notification's action (primary or secondary) to pending state by its unique identifier **notificationId** and action type **actionType**.

<h3 id="revert-a-notification-action-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|notificationId|path|string|true|The identifier of the notification|
|actionType|path|string|true|The type of action (primary or secondary)|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|actionType|primary|
|actionType|secondary|

## Mark notifications as seen

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_markNotificationsAsSeen"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/seen \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "notificationIds": [
      "string"
    ],
    "tags": {},
    "data": "string",
    "contextKeys": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/seen`

Mark specific and multiple in-app (inbox) notifications as seen. Supports context-based filtering.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "notificationIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "tags": {},
  "data": "string",
  "contextKeys": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="mark-notifications-as-seen-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|body|body|[MarkSubscriberNotificationsAsSeenDto](#schemamarksubscribernotificationsasseendto)|true|none|
|» notificationIds|body|[string]|false|Specific notification IDs to mark as seen|
|» tags|body|object|false|Filter notifications by workflow tags (OR for string[], or { and: [{ or: string[] }, ...] } for AND of OR-groups).|
|» data|body|string|false|Filter notifications by data attributes (JSON string)|
|» contextKeys|body|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering notifications|

## Mark all notifications as read

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_markAllNotificationsAsRead"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/read \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "tags": {},
    "data": "string",
    "contextKeys": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/read`

Mark all in-app (inbox) notifications matching the specified filters as read. Supports context-based filtering.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "tags": {},
  "data": "string",
  "contextKeys": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="mark-all-notifications-as-read-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|body|body|[UpdateAllSubscriberNotificationsDto](#schemaupdateallsubscribernotificationsdto)|true|none|
|» tags|body|object|false|Filter notifications by workflow tags (OR for string[], or { and: [{ or: string[] }, ...] } for AND of OR-groups).|
|» data|body|string|false|Filter notifications by data attributes (JSON string)|
|» contextKeys|body|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering notifications|

## Archive all read notifications

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_archiveAllReadNotifications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/read-archive \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "tags": {},
    "data": "string",
    "contextKeys": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/read-archive`

Archive all read in-app (inbox) notifications matching the specified filters. Supports context-based filtering.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "tags": {},
  "data": "string",
  "contextKeys": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="archive-all-read-notifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|body|body|[UpdateAllSubscriberNotificationsDto](#schemaupdateallsubscribernotificationsdto)|true|none|
|» tags|body|object|false|Filter notifications by workflow tags (OR for string[], or { and: [{ or: string[] }, ...] } for AND of OR-groups).|
|» data|body|string|false|Filter notifications by data attributes (JSON string)|
|» contextKeys|body|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering notifications|

## Delete all notifications

<a id="opIdSubscribersController_deleteAllNotifications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/subscribers/string/notifications/delete \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "tags": {},
    "data": "string",
    "contextKeys": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v2/subscribers/{subscriberId}/notifications/delete`

Permanently delete all in-app (inbox) notifications matching the specified filters. Supports context-based filtering.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "tags": {},
  "data": "string",
  "contextKeys": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="delete-all-notifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|path|string|true|The identifier of the subscriber|
|body|body|[UpdateAllSubscriberNotificationsDto](#schemaupdateallsubscribernotificationsdto)|true|none|
|» tags|body|object|false|Filter notifications by workflow tags (OR for string[], or { and: [{ or: string[] }, ...] } for AND of OR-groups).|
|» data|body|string|false|Filter notifications by data attributes (JSON string)|
|» contextKeys|body|[string]|false|Context keys for filtering notifications|

<h1 id="novu-api-topics">Topics</h1>

Topics are a way to group subscribers together so that they can be notified of events at once. A topic is identified by a custom key. This can be helpful for things like sending out marketing emails or notifying users of new features. Topics can also be used to send notifications to the subscribers who have been grouped together based on their interests, location, activities and much more.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/subscribers/topics">External documentation</a>

## Check topic subscriber

<a id="opIdTopicsV1Controller_getTopicSubscriber"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/topics/string/subscribers/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/topics/{topicKey}/subscribers/{externalSubscriberId}`

Check if a subscriber belongs to a certain topic

<h3 id="check-topic-subscriber-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|externalSubscriberId|path|string|true|The external subscriber id|
|topicKey|path|string|true|The topic key|

## List all topics

<a id="opIdTopicsController_listTopics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/topics`

This api returns a paginated list of topics.
    Topics can be filtered by **key**, **name**, or **includeCursor** to paginate through the list. 
    Checkout all available filters in the query section.

<h3 id="list-all-topics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return (max 100)|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|key|query|string|false|Key of the topic to filter results.|
|name|query|string|false|Name of the topic to filter results.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create a topic

<a id="opIdTopicsController_upsertTopic"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "task:12345",
    "name": "Task Title",
    "data": {
      "category": "product",
      "priority": 1
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v2/topics`

Creates a new topic if it does not exist, or updates an existing topic if it already exists. Use ?failIfExists=true to prevent updates.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "key": "task:12345",
  "name": "Task Title",
  "data": {
    "category": "product",
    "priority": 1
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-topic-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|failIfExists|query|boolean|false|If true, the request will fail if a topic with the same key already exists|
|body|body|[CreateUpdateTopicRequestDto](#schemacreateupdatetopicrequestdto)|true|none|
|» key|body|string|true|The unique key identifier for the topic. The key must contain only alphanumeric characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9), hyphens (-), underscores (_), colons (:), or be a valid email address.|
|» name|body|string|false|The display name for the topic|
|» data|body|object \| null|false|Additional custom data associated with the topic. Flat key-value pairs of scalars (string, number, boolean, string[]). Maximum size: 64KB.|

## Delete a topic

<a id="opIdTopicsController_deleteTopic"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v2/topics/{topicKey}`

Delete a topic by its unique key identifier **topicKey**. 
    This action is irreversible and will remove all subscriptions to the topic.

<h3 id="delete-a-topic-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|topicKey|path|string|true|The key identifier of the topic|

## Update a topic

<a id="opIdTopicsController_updateTopic"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Updated Topic Name",
    "data": {
      "category": "product",
      "priority": 1
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v2/topics/{topicKey}`

Update a topic name or data by its unique key identifier **topicKey**

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Updated Topic Name",
  "data": {
    "category": "product",
    "priority": 1
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-topic-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|topicKey|path|string|true|The key identifier of the topic|
|body|body|[UpdateTopicRequestDto](#schemaupdatetopicrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|The display name for the topic|
|» data|body|object \| null|false|Additional custom data associated with the topic. Flat key-value pairs of scalars (string, number, boolean, string[]). Maximum size: 64KB. Pass null to clear.|

```json
      "priority": 1
```

## List topic subscriptions

<a id="opIdTopicsController_listTopicSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics/string/subscriptions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/topics/{topicKey}/subscriptions`

List all subscriptions of subscribers for a topic.
    Checkout all available filters in the query section.

<h3 id="list-topic-subscriptions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|topicKey|path|string|true|The key identifier of the topic|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return (max 100)|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|subscriberId|query|string|false|Filter by subscriber ID|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Filter by exact context keys, order insensitive (format: "type:id")|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create topic subscriptions

<a id="opIdTopicsController_createTopicSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics/string/subscriptions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "subscriberIds": [
      "subscriberId1",
      "subscriberId2"
    ],
    "subscriptions": [
      {
        "identifier": "subscriber-123-subscription-a",
        "subscriberId": "subscriber-123"
      },
      {
        "identifier": "subscriber-456-subscription-b",
        "subscriberId": "subscriber-456"
      }
    ],
    "name": "My Topic",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    },
    "preferences": [
      {
        "workflowId": "workflow-123",
        "condition": {
          "===": [
            {
              "var": "payload.tier"
            },
            "premium"
          ]
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v2/topics/{topicKey}/subscriptions`

This api will create subscription for subscriberIds for a topic. 
      Its like subscribing to a common interest group. if topic does not exist, it will be created.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscriberIds": [
    "subscriberId1",
    "subscriberId2"
  ],
  "subscriptions": [
    {
      "identifier": "subscriber-123-subscription-a",
      "subscriberId": "subscriber-123"
    },
    {
      "identifier": "subscriber-456-subscription-b",
      "subscriberId": "subscriber-456"
    }
  ],
  "name": "My Topic",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "preferences": [
    {
      "workflowId": "workflow-123",
      "condition": {
        "===": [
          {
            "var": "payload.tier"
          },
          "premium"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-topic-subscriptions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|topicKey|path|string|true|The key identifier of the topic|
|body|body|[CreateTopicSubscriptionsRequestDto](#schemacreatetopicsubscriptionsrequestdto)|true|none|
|» subscriberIds|body|[string]|false|**Deprecated.** List of subscriber IDs to subscribe to the topic (max: 100). @deprecated Use the "subscriptions" property instead.|
|» subscriptions|body|[string \| [TopicSubscriberIdentifierDto](#schematopicsubscriberidentifierdto)]|false|List of subscriptions to subscribe to the topic (max: 100). Can be either a string array of subscriber IDs or an array of objects with identifier and subscriberId|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[TopicSubscriberIdentifierDto](#schematopicsubscriberidentifierdto)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the topic|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|
|» preferences|body|[string \| [WorkflowPreferenceRequestDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencerequestdto) \| [GroupPreferenceFilterDto](#schemagrouppreferencefilterdto)]|false|The preferences of the topic. Can be a simple workflow ID string, workflow preference object, or group filter object|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowPreferenceRequestDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencerequestdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[GroupPreferenceFilterDto](#schemagrouppreferencefilterdto)|false|none|

## Delete topic subscriptions

<a id="opIdTopicsController_deleteTopicSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics/string/subscriptions \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "subscriberIds": [
      "subscriberId1",
      "subscriberId2"
    ],
    "subscriptions": [
      {
        "identifier": "subscriber-123-subscription-a",
        "subscriberId": "subscriber-123"
      },
      {
        "subscriberId": "subscriber-456"
      },
      {
        "identifier": "subscriber-789-subscription-b"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`DELETE /v2/topics/{topicKey}/subscriptions`

Delete subscriptions for subscriberIds for a topic.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscriberIds": [
    "subscriberId1",
    "subscriberId2"
  ],
  "subscriptions": [
    {
      "identifier": "subscriber-123-subscription-a",
      "subscriberId": "subscriber-123"
    },
    {
      "subscriberId": "subscriber-456"
    },
    {
      "identifier": "subscriber-789-subscription-b"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="delete-topic-subscriptions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|topicKey|path|string|true|The key identifier of the topic|
|body|body|[DeleteTopicSubscriptionsRequestDto](#schemadeletetopicsubscriptionsrequestdto)|true|none|
|» subscriberIds|body|[string]|false|**Deprecated.** List of subscriber identifiers to unsubscribe from the topic (max: 100). @deprecated Use the "subscriptions" property instead.|
|» subscriptions|body|[string \| [DeleteTopicSubscriberIdentifierDto](#schemadeletetopicsubscriberidentifierdto)]|false|List of subscriptions to unsubscribe from the topic (max: 100). Can be either a string array of subscriber IDs or an array of objects with identifier and/or subscriberId. If only subscriberId is provided, all subscriptions for that subscriber within the topic will be deleted.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DeleteTopicSubscriberIdentifierDto](#schemadeletetopicsubscriberidentifierdto)|false|none|

## Retrieve a topic subscription

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics/string/subscriptions/string \
```

`GET /v2/topics/{topicKey}/subscriptions/{identifier}`

## Update a topic subscription

<a id="opIdTopicsController_updateTopicSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/topics/string/subscriptions/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "My Subscription",
    "preferences": [
      {
        "workflowId": "workflow-123",
        "condition": {
          "===": [
            {
              "var": "payload.tier"
            },
            "premium"
          ]
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PATCH /v2/topics/{topicKey}/subscriptions/{identifier}`

Update a subscription by its unique identifier for a topic. You can update the preferences and name associated with the subscription.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "My Subscription",
  "preferences": [
    {
      "workflowId": "workflow-123",
      "condition": {
        "===": [
          {
            "var": "payload.tier"
          },
          "premium"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-topic-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|topicKey|path|string|true|The key identifier of the topic|
|identifier|path|string|true|The unique identifier of the subscription|
|body|body|[UpdateTopicSubscriptionRequestDto](#schemaupdatetopicsubscriptionrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|The name of the subscription|
|» preferences|body|[string \| [WorkflowPreferenceRequestDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencerequestdto) \| [GroupPreferenceFilterDto](#schemagrouppreferencefilterdto)]|false|The preferences of the topic. Can be a simple workflow ID string, workflow preference object, or group filter object|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowPreferenceRequestDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencerequestdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[GroupPreferenceFilterDto](#schemagrouppreferencefilterdto)|false|none|

<h1 id="novu-api-integrations">Integrations</h1>

With the help of the Integration Store, you can easily integrate your favorite delivery provider. During the runtime of the API, the Integrations Store is responsible for storing the configurations of all the providers.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/platform/integrations/overview">External documentation</a>

## List all integrations

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_listIntegrations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/integrations`

List all the channels integrations created in the organization. Only integration metadata is returned, credentials field is returned as an empty object.

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The list of integrations belonging to the organization that are successfully returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method Not Allowed|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|409|Conflict|Conflict|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|413|Payload Too Large|Payload Too Large|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|414|URI Too Long|URI Too Long|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Unsupported Media Type|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable Entity|[ValidationErrorDto](#schemavalidationerrordto)|
|429|Too Many Requests|The client has sent too many requests in a given amount of time. |Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error|[ErrorDto](#schemaerrordto)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|Inline|

```bash
      "token": "string",
      "from": "string",
      "senderName": "string",
      "projectName": "string",
      "applicationId": "string",
      "clientId": "string",
      "requireTls": true,
      "ignoreTls": true,
      "tlsOptions": {},
      "baseUrl": "string",
      "webhookUrl": "string",
      "redirectUrl": "string",
      "hmac": true,
      "serviceAccount": "string",
      "ipPoolName": "string",

      "apiKeyRequestHeader": "string",
      "secretKeyRequestHeader": "string",
      "idPath": "string",
      "datePath": "string",
      "apiToken": "string",
      "authenticateByToken": true,
      "authenticationTokenKey": "string",
      "instanceId": "string",
      "alertUid": "string",
      "title": "string",
      "imageUrl": "string",
      "state": "string",
      "externalLink": "string",
      "channelId": "string",
      "phoneNumberIdentification": "string",
      "accessKey": "string",
      "appSid": "string",
      "senderId": "string",
      "tenantId": "string",
      "AppIOBaseUrl": "string",
      "signingSecret": "string",
      "outboundIntegrationId": "string",
```

`POST /v1/integrations`

Create an integration for the current environment the user is based on the API key provided. 
    Each provider supports different credentials, check the provider documentation for more details. Only integration metadata is returned, credentials field is returned as an empty object.

## List active integrations

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_getActiveIntegrations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/active \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/integrations/active`

List all the active integrations created in the organization. Only integration metadata is returned, credentials field is returned as an empty object.

`PUT /v1/integrations/{integrationId}`

<h3 id="update-an-integration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|integrationId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateIntegrationRequestDto](#schemaupdateintegrationrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» identifier|body|string|false|none|
|» _environmentId|body|string|false|none|
|» active|body|boolean|false|If the integration is active the validation on the credentials field will run|
|» credentials|body|[CredentialsDto](#schemacredentialsdto)|false|none|
|» check|body|boolean|false|none|
|» conditions|body|[[StepFilterDto](#schemastepfilterdto)]|false|**Deprecated.** Legacy StepFilter conditions. Ignored when `rules` is also set.|
|» rules|body|object \| null|false|JSONLogic used at send time to select this integration. Takes precedence over `conditions`.|
|» configurations|body|object|false|Configurations for the integration|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|

## Delete an integration

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_removeIntegration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/integrations/{integrationId}`

Delete an integration by its unique key identifier **integrationId**. 
    This action is irreversible. Only integration metadata is returned, credentials field is returned as empty object.

<h3 id="delete-an-integration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|integrationId|path|string|true|none|

## Auto-configure an integration for inbound webhooks

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_autoConfigureIntegration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/string/auto-configure \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /v1/integrations/{integrationId}/auto-configure`

Auto-configure an integration by its unique key identifier **integrationId** for inbound webhook support. 
    This will automatically generate required webhook signing keys and configure webhook endpoints. Only integration metadata is returned, credentials field is returned as an empty object.

<h3 id="auto-configure-an-integration-for-inbound-webhooks-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|integrationId|path|string|true|none|

## Update integration as primary

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_setIntegrationAsPrimary"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/string/set-primary \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /v1/integrations/{integrationId}/set-primary`

Update an integration as **primary** by its unique key identifier **integrationId**. 
    This API will set the integration as primary for that channel in the current environment. 
    Primary integration is used to deliver notification for sms and email channels in the workflow. 
    Only integration metadata is returned, credentials field is returned as an empty object.

<h3 id="update-integration-as-primary-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|integrationId|path|string|true|none|
