## Generate chat OAuth URL

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_getChatOAuthUrl"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/chat/oauth \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
    "integrationIdentifier": "string",
    "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    },
    "scope": [
      "chat:write",
      "chat:write.public",
      "channels:read",
      "groups:read",
      "users:read",
      "users:read.email",
      "incoming-webhook"
    ],
    "userScope": [
      "identity.basic"
    ],
    "mode": "link_user",
    "connectionMode": "shared",
    "autoLinkUser": true
  }'
```

`POST /v1/integrations/chat/oauth`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

**Deprecated** — use `POST /integrations/channel-connections/oauth` (connect) or `POST /integrations/channel-endpoints/oauth` (link_user) instead.
    Generate an OAuth URL for chat integrations like Slack, MS Teams, and Webex.
    This URL allows subscribers to authorize the integration, enabling the system to send messages 
    through their chat workspace. The generated URL expires after 5 minutes.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "scope": [
    "chat:write",
    "chat:write.public",
    "channels:read",
    "groups:read",
    "users:read",
    "users:read.email",
    "incoming-webhook"
  ],
  "userScope": [
    "identity.basic"
  ],
  "mode": "link_user",
  "connectionMode": "shared",
  "autoLinkUser": true
}
```

<h3 id="generate-chat-oauth-url-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[GenerateChatOauthUrlRequestDto](#schemageneratechatoauthurlrequestdto)|true|none|
|» subscriberId|body|string|false|The subscriber ID to link the channel connection to. For Slack: Required for incoming webhook endpoints, optional for workspace connections. For MS Teams: Optional. Admin consent is tenant-wide and can be associated with a subscriber for organizational purposes.|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|true|Integration identifier|
|» connectionIdentifier|body|string|false|Identifier of the channel connection that will be created. It is generated automatically if not provided.|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|
|» scope|body|[string]|false|**Slack only**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. These define the permissions your Slack integration will have. If not specified, default scopes will be used: chat:write, chat:write.public, channels:read, groups:read, users:read, users:read.email. **Webex**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. Defaults to: spark:messages_write, spark:rooms_read, spark:people_read, spark:memberships_read, spark:kms. **MS Teams**: This parameter is ignored. MS Teams uses admin consent with pre-configured permissions in Azure AD. Note: The generated OAuth URL expires after 5 minutes.|
|» userScope|body|[string]|false|**Slack only, link_user mode**: User-level OAuth scopes to request during authorization. Used when mode is "link_user" to identify the Slack user via "Sign in with Slack". If not specified, defaults to: identity.basic.|
|» mode|body|string|false|OAuth flow mode. Use "connect" (default) to create a workspace channel connection, or "link_user" to identify the subscriber's Slack user ID without creating a connection.|
|» connectionMode|body|string|false|Connection mode that determines how the channel connection is scoped. Use "subscriber" (default) to associate the connection with a specific subscriber. Use "shared" to associate the connection with a context instead of a subscriber — subscriberId will not be stored on the connection.|
|» autoLinkUser|body|boolean|false|When true, after the workspace/tenant connection is created the OAuth flow also links the subscriber who clicked "Connect" as a personal endpoint. For Slack, this uses the authed_user.id already returned by oauth.v2.access — no extra redirect. For Webex, this uses the authenticated Webex person returned by people/me — no extra redirect. For MS Teams, this triggers a second OAuth redirect for delegated user-identity consent. Defaults to false when omitted; the SlackConnectButton and MsTeamsConnectButton SDK components default this to true.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» mode|connect|
|» mode|link_user|
|» connectionMode|subscriber|
|» connectionMode|shared|

## Generate OAuth URL for a workspace/tenant connection

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_generateConnectOAuthUrl"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/channel-connections/oauth \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
    "integrationIdentifier": "string",
    "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    },
    "contextHash": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
    "scope": [
      "chat:write",
      "chat:write.public",
      "channels:read"
    ],
    "connectionMode": "shared",
    "autoLinkUser": true
  }'
```

`POST /v1/integrations/channel-connections/oauth`

Generate an OAuth URL that creates a workspace or tenant-level channel connection (Slack workspace install, MS Teams admin consent, or Webex integration authorization).
    The generated URL expires after 5 minutes.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "contextHash": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  "scope": [
    "chat:write",
    "chat:write.public",
    "channels:read"
  ],
  "connectionMode": "shared",
  "autoLinkUser": true
}
```

<h3 id="generate-oauth-url-for-a-workspacetenant-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[GenerateConnectOauthUrlRequestDto](#schemagenerateconnectoauthurlrequestdto)|true|none|
|» subscriberId|body|string|false|The subscriber ID to associate with the channel connection. For Slack: optional for workspace connections (required only for incoming-webhook scope). For Webex: optional for workspace connections. For MS Teams: optional. Admin consent is tenant-wide.|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|true|Integration identifier|
|» connectionIdentifier|body|string|false|Identifier of the channel connection that will be created. Generated automatically if not provided.|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|
|» contextHash|body|string|false|HMAC-SHA256 of the canonicalized `context`, signed with the tenant environment secret key (the same "Inbox with context" signing scheme). Required when the integration has HMAC validation enabled and the session did not already HMAC-verify the context. Establishes that the context/tenant binding was minted by an authenticated backend rather than forged in the browser.|
|» scope|body|[string]|false|**Slack only**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. If not specified, default scopes will be used: chat:write, chat:write.public, channels:read, groups:read, users:read, users:read.email. **Webex**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. Defaults to: spark:messages_write, spark:rooms_read, spark:people_read, spark:memberships_read, spark:kms. **MS Teams**: ignored — uses admin consent with pre-configured Azure AD permissions.|
|» connectionMode|body|string|false|Connection mode that determines how the channel connection is scoped. "subscriber" (default) associates the connection with a specific subscriber. "shared" associates the connection with a context instead of a subscriber.|
|» autoLinkUser|body|boolean|false|When true (default when connectionMode is "subscriber"), after the workspace/tenant connection is created the OAuth flow also links the subscriber who clicked "Connect" as a personal endpoint. For Slack, uses the authed_user.id returned by oauth.v2.access — no extra redirect. For Webex, uses the authenticated Webex person returned by people/me — no extra redirect. For MS Teams, triggers a second OAuth redirect for delegated user-identity consent. Set to false to only create the workspace connection without linking the individual user.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» connectionMode|subscriber|
|» connectionMode|shared|

## Generate OAuth URL to link a subscriber user identity

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_generateLinkUserOAuthUrl"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/channel-endpoints/oauth \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
    "integrationIdentifier": "string",
    "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    },
    "contextHash": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
    "userScope": [
      "identity.basic"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v1/integrations/channel-endpoints/oauth`

Generate an OAuth URL that links a specific subscriber to their chat identity (Slack user ID, MS Teams user OID, or Webex person).
    The generated URL expires after 5 minutes.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "contextHash": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  "userScope": [
    "identity.basic"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="generate-oauth-url-to-link-a-subscriber-user-identity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[GenerateLinkUserOauthUrlRequestDto](#schemageneratelinkuseroauthurlrequestdto)|true|none|
|» subscriberId|body|string|true|The subscriber ID to link to their chat identity. Required — this operation always binds a specific subscriber to a user identity in the chat provider.|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|true|Integration identifier|
|» connectionIdentifier|body|string|false|Identifier of the existing channel connection to associate this user endpoint with. Generated automatically if not provided for providers that support standalone user linking. Required for Webex.|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|
|» contextHash|body|string|false|HMAC-SHA256 of the canonicalized `context`, signed with the tenant environment secret key (the same "Inbox with context" signing scheme). Required when the integration has HMAC validation enabled and the session did not already HMAC-verify the context, so the per-user link carries a trustworthy subscriber/tenant binding.|
|» userScope|body|[string]|false|**Slack only**: User-level OAuth scopes for "Sign in with Slack". Defaults to: identity.basic. **Webex**: Optional Webex scopes for people/me; defaults to spark:people_read. **MS Teams**: ignored — uses delegated OpenID scopes (openid, profile, User.Read).|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "data": {
    "url": "https://slack.com/oauth/v2/authorize?state=..."
  }
}
```

## Issue a URL to link a subscriber chat identity

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_linkChannelEndpoint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/channel-endpoints/link \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "integrationIdentifier": "telegram-bot",
    "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    },
    "contextHash": "a1b2c3d4e5f6..."
  }'
```

`POST /v1/integrations/channel-endpoints/link`

Returns a provider-specific URL the subscriber opens to link their chat identity. The integration provider is resolved from integrationIdentifier; Telegram returns a deep link.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "integrationIdentifier": "telegram-bot",
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "contextHash": "a1b2c3d4e5f6..."
}
```

<h3 id="issue-a-url-to-link-a-subscriber-chat-identity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[LinkChannelEndpointRequestDto](#schemalinkchannelendpointrequestdto)|true|none|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|true|Integration identifier for the chat provider integration|
|» subscriberId|body|string|true|External subscriber identifier to link to their chat identity|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|
|» contextHash|body|string|false|HMAC-SHA256 of the canonicalized `context`, signed with the tenant environment secret key (the same "Inbox with context" signing scheme). Required when the integration has HMAC validation enabled.|

## Configure a chat integration webhook

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_configureIntegrationWebhook"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/string/webhook/configure \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /v1/integrations/{integrationIdentifier}/webhook/configure`

Registers the Novu webhook URL with the chat provider for the specified integration. Telegram is the only supported provider initially.

<h3 id="configure-a-chat-integration-webhook-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|integrationIdentifier|path|string|true|none|

## Issue a short-lived mobile setup link for an existing integration

<a id="opIdIntegrationsController_createIntegrationMobileLink"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/integrations/string/mobile-link \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "subscriberId": "subscriber-123"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/integrations/{integrationIdentifier}/mobile-link`

Returns an opaque, single-use setup token plus a mobile URL for configuring an existing chat integration. Telegram is the only supported provider initially.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123"
}
```

<h3 id="issue-a-short-lived-mobile-setup-link-for-an-existing-integration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|integrationIdentifier|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[IssueIntegrationMobileLinkRequestDto](#schemaissueintegrationmobilelinkrequestdto)|true|none|
|» subscriberId|body|string|false|Optional subscriber to link via `/start` deep link after mobile setup completes. When provided, the consume response may include a ready-to-open Telegram deep link.|

<h1 id="novu-api-workflows">Workflows</h1>

All notifications are sent via a workflow. Each workflow acts as a container for the logic and blueprint that are associated with a type of notification in your system.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/workflows">External documentation</a>

## List all workflows

<a id="opIdWorkflowController_searchWorkflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/workflows \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/workflows`

Retrieves a list of workflows with optional filtering and pagination

<h3 id="list-all-workflows-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|query|number|false|Number of items to return per page|
|offset|query|number|false|Number of items to skip before starting to return results|
|orderDirection|query|[DirectionEnum](#schemadirectionenum)|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|[WorkflowResponseDtoSortField](#schemaworkflowresponsedtosortfield)|false|Field to sort the results by|
|query|query|string|false|Search query to filter workflows|
|tags|query|[string]|false|Filter workflows by tags|
|status|query|[[WorkflowStatusEnum](#schemaworkflowstatusenum)]|false|Filter workflows by status|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|
|orderBy|createdAt|
|orderBy|updatedAt|
|orderBy|name|
|orderBy|lastTriggeredAt|
|status|ACTIVE|
|status|INACTIVE|
|status|ERROR|

<h3 id="create-a-workflow-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateWorkflowDto](#schemacreateworkflowdto)|true|Workflow creation details|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the workflow|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the workflow|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags associated with the workflow|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Whether the workflow is active|
|» validatePayload|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable payload schema validation|
|» payloadSchema|body|object \| null|false|The payload JSON Schema for the workflow|
|» isTranslationEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable translations for this workflow|
|» agent|body|object \| null|false|Optional agent assignment used to route this workflow through an agent's connected channels. Pass null to clear.|
|» » identifier|body|string|true|Public agent identifier used to route this workflow through an agent's connected channels.|
|» » providers|body|object|false|Optional per-provider overrides keyed by providerId (e.g. novu-email-agent). Today only Novu Email replyTo is supported.|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » replyTo|body|string|false|none|
|» workflowId|body|string|true|Unique identifier for the workflow|
|» steps|body|[[InAppStepUpsertDto](#schemainappstepupsertdto) \| [EmailStepUpsertDto](#schemaemailstepupsertdto) \| [SmsStepUpsertDto](#schemasmsstepupsertdto) \| [PushStepUpsertDto](#schemapushstepupsertdto) \| [ChatStepUpsertDto](#schemachatstepupsertdto) \| [DelayStepUpsertDto](#schemadelaystepupsertdto) \| [DigestStepUpsertDto](#schemadigeststepupsertdto) \| [ThrottleStepUpsertDto](#schemathrottlestepupsertdto) \| [ToolStepUpsertDto](#schematoolstepupsertdto) \| [CustomStepUpsertDto](#schemacustomstepupsertdto) \| [HttpRequestStepUpsertDto](#schemahttprequeststepupsertdto)]|true|Steps of the workflow|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[InAppStepUpsertDto](#schemainappstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[EmailStepUpsertDto](#schemaemailstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SmsStepUpsertDto](#schemasmsstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[PushStepUpsertDto](#schemapushstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ChatStepUpsertDto](#schemachatstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DelayStepUpsertDto](#schemadelaystepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DigestStepUpsertDto](#schemadigeststepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ThrottleStepUpsertDto](#schemathrottlestepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ToolStepUpsertDto](#schematoolstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[CustomStepUpsertDto](#schemacustomstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[HttpRequestStepUpsertDto](#schemahttprequeststepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» __source|body|object|false|Source of workflow creation|
|» preferences|body|object|false|Workflow preferences|
|» » user|body|[WorkflowPreferencesDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencesdto) \| null|false|User workflow preferences|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowPreferencesDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencesdto)|false|none|
|» » workflow|body|object \| null|false|Workflow-specific preferences|
|» » » all|body|[WorkflowPreferenceDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencedto)|true|A preference for the workflow. The values specified here will be used if no preference is specified for a channel.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|true|A flag specifying if notification delivery is enabled for the workflow. If true, notification delivery is enabled by default for all channels. This setting can be overridden by the channel preferences.|
|» » » » readOnly|body|boolean|true|A flag specifying if the preference is read-only. If true, the preference cannot be changed by the Subscriber.|
|» » » » condition|body|object|false|JsonLogic condition controlling whether this preference applies|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowPreferenceDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencedto)|false|none|
|» » » channels|body|object|true|Preferences for different communication channels|
|» » » » **additionalProperties**|body|[ChannelPreferenceDto](#schemachannelpreferencedto)|false|none|
|» severity|body|object|false|Severity of the workflow|

## Sync a workflow

<a id="opIdWorkflowController_sync"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/workflows/string/sync \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "targetEnvironmentId": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /v2/workflows/{workflowId}/sync`

Synchronizes a workflow to the target environment

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "targetEnvironmentId": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="sync-a-workflow-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workflowId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[SyncWorkflowDto](#schemasyncworkflowdto)|true|Sync workflow details|
|» targetEnvironmentId|body|string|true|Target environment identifier to sync the workflow to|

## Retrieve a workflow

<a id="opIdWorkflowController_getWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/workflows/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/workflows/{workflowId}`

Fetches details of a specific workflow by its unique identifier **workflowId**

<h3 id="retrieve-a-workflow-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workflowId|path|string|true|none|
|environmentId|query|string|false|none|

## Update a workflow

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/workflows/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "tags": [
      "string"
    ],
    "active": false,
    "validatePayload": true,
    "payloadSchema": {},
    "isTranslationEnabled": false,
    "agent": {
      "identifier": "string",

        "property1": {
          "replyTo": "string"
        },
        "property2": {

        }

    "workflowId": "string",

      {
        "_id": "string",

        "type": "in_app",
        "controlValues": {
          "skip": {
            "and": [
              {
                "==": [
                  {
                    "var": "payload.tier"
                  },
                  "pro"
                ]
              },
              {
                "==": [
                  {
                    "var": "subscriber.data.role"
                  },
                  "admin"
                ]
              },
              {
                ">": [
                  {
                    "var": "payload.amount"
                  },
                  "4"
                ]
              }
            ]
          },
          "body": "string",
          "subject": "string",
          "avatar": "string",
          "primaryAction": {
            "label": "string",
            "redirect": {
              "url": "string",
              "target": "_self"
            }
          },
          "secondaryAction": {
            "label": "string",
            "redirect": {
              "url": "string",
              "target": "_self"
            }
          },
          "redirect": {
            "url": "string",
            "target": "_self"
          },
          "disableOutputSanitization": false,
          "data": {}
        }
      }
    ],
    "preferences": {

        "all": {

          "condition": {}

        "channels": {
```

<h3 id="update-a-workflow-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workflowId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateWorkflowDto](#schemaupdateworkflowdto)|true|Workflow update details|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the workflow|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the workflow|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags associated with the workflow|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Whether the workflow is active|
|» validatePayload|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable payload schema validation|
|» payloadSchema|body|object \| null|false|The payload JSON Schema for the workflow|
|» isTranslationEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable translations for this workflow|
|» agent|body|object \| null|false|Optional agent assignment used to route this workflow through an agent's connected channels. Pass null to clear.|
|» » identifier|body|string|true|Public agent identifier used to route this workflow through an agent's connected channels.|
|» » providers|body|object|false|Optional per-provider overrides keyed by providerId (e.g. novu-email-agent). Today only Novu Email replyTo is supported.|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » replyTo|body|string|false|none|
|» workflowId|body|string|false|Workflow ID (allowed only for code-first workflows)|
|» steps|body|[[InAppStepUpsertDto](#schemainappstepupsertdto) \| [EmailStepUpsertDto](#schemaemailstepupsertdto) \| [SmsStepUpsertDto](#schemasmsstepupsertdto) \| [PushStepUpsertDto](#schemapushstepupsertdto) \| [ChatStepUpsertDto](#schemachatstepupsertdto) \| [DelayStepUpsertDto](#schemadelaystepupsertdto) \| [DigestStepUpsertDto](#schemadigeststepupsertdto) \| [ThrottleStepUpsertDto](#schemathrottlestepupsertdto) \| [ToolStepUpsertDto](#schematoolstepupsertdto) \| [CustomStepUpsertDto](#schemacustomstepupsertdto) \| [HttpRequestStepUpsertDto](#schemahttprequeststepupsertdto)]|true|Steps of the workflow|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[InAppStepUpsertDto](#schemainappstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[EmailStepUpsertDto](#schemaemailstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SmsStepUpsertDto](#schemasmsstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[PushStepUpsertDto](#schemapushstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ChatStepUpsertDto](#schemachatstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DelayStepUpsertDto](#schemadelaystepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DigestStepUpsertDto](#schemadigeststepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ThrottleStepUpsertDto](#schemathrottlestepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ToolStepUpsertDto](#schematoolstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[CustomStepUpsertDto](#schemacustomstepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[HttpRequestStepUpsertDto](#schemahttprequeststepupsertdto)|false|none|
|» preferences|body|object|true|Workflow preferences|
|» » user|body|[WorkflowPreferencesDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencesdto) \| null|false|User workflow preferences|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowPreferencesDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencesdto)|false|none|
|» » workflow|body|object \| null|false|Workflow-specific preferences|
|» » » all|body|[WorkflowPreferenceDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencedto)|true|A preference for the workflow. The values specified here will be used if no preference is specified for a channel.|
|» » » » enabled|body|boolean|true|A flag specifying if notification delivery is enabled for the workflow. If true, notification delivery is enabled by default for all channels. This setting can be overridden by the channel preferences.|
|» » » » readOnly|body|boolean|true|A flag specifying if the preference is read-only. If true, the preference cannot be changed by the Subscriber.|
|» » » » condition|body|object|false|JsonLogic condition controlling whether this preference applies|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|[WorkflowPreferenceDto](#schemaworkflowpreferencedto)|false|none|
|» » » channels|body|object|true|Preferences for different communication channels|
|» » » » **additionalProperties**|body|[ChannelPreferenceDto](#schemachannelpreferencedto)|false|none|
|» origin|body|object|false|Origin of the workflow. Accepted for backwards compatibility but ignored on update.|
|» severity|body|object|false|Severity of the workflow|

## Delete a workflow

<a id="opIdWorkflowController_removeWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/workflows/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

## Update a workflow

<a id="opIdWorkflowController_patchWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/workflows/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "active": true,
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "tags": [
      "string"
    ],
    "payloadSchema": {},
    "validatePayload": true,
    "isTranslationEnabled": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /v2/workflows/{workflowId}`

Partially updates a workflow by its unique identifier **workflowId**

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "active": true,
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "tags": [
    "string"
  ],
  "payloadSchema": {},
  "validatePayload": true,
  "isTranslationEnabled": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-workflow-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workflowId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[PatchWorkflowDto](#schemapatchworkflowdto)|true|Workflow patch details|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Activate or deactivate the workflow|
|» name|body|string|false|New name for the workflow|
|» description|body|string|false|Updated description of the workflow|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags associated with the workflow|
|» payloadSchema|body|object \| null|false|The payload JSON Schema for the workflow|
|» validatePayload|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable payload schema validation|
|» isTranslationEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable translations for this workflow|

<h1 id="novu-api-messages">Messages</h1>

A message in Novu represents a notification delivered to a recipient on a particular channel. Messages contain information about the request that triggered its delivery, a view of the data sent to the recipient, and a timeline of its lifecycle events. Learn more about messages.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/workflows/messages">External documentation</a>

## List all messages

<a id="opIdMessagesController_getMessages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/messages \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/messages`

List all messages for the current environment. 
    This API supports filtering by **channel**, **subscriberId**, and **transactionId**. 
    This API returns a paginated list of messages.

<h3 id="list-all-messages-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel|query|[ChannelTypeEnum](#schemachanneltypeenum)|false|none|
|subscriberId|query|string|false|none|
|transactionId|query|[string]|false|none|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Filter by exact context keys, order insensitive (format: "type:id")|
|page|query|number|false|none|
|limit|query|number|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|channel|in_app|
|channel|email|
|channel|sms|
|channel|chat|
|channel|push|
|channel|tool|

## Delete a message

<a id="opIdMessagesController_deleteMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/messages/507f1f77bcf86cd799439011 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/messages/{messageId}`

Delete a message entity from the Novu platform by **messageId**. 
    This action is irreversible. **messageId** is required and of mongodbId type.

<h3 id="delete-a-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|messageId|path|string|true|none|

## Delete messages by transactionId

<a id="opIdMessagesController_deleteMessagesByTransactionId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/messages/transaction/507f1f77bcf86cd799439011 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/messages/transaction/{transactionId}`

Delete multiple messages from the Novu platform using **transactionId** of triggered event. 
    This API supports filtering by **channel** and delete all messages associated with the **transactionId**.

<h3 id="delete-messages-by-transactionid-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channel|query|string|false|The channel of the message to be deleted|
|transactionId|path|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|channel|in_app|
|channel|email|
|channel|sms|
|channel|chat|
|channel|push|
|channel|tool|

<h1 id="novu-api-environments">Environments</h1>

Environments allow you to manage different stages of your application development lifecycle. Each environment has its own set of API keys and configurations, enabling you to separate development, staging, and production workflows.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/platform/environments">External documentation</a>

## List all environments

<a id="opIdEnvironmentsControllerV1_listMyEnvironments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/environments`

This API returns a list of environments for the current organization. 
    Each environment contains its configuration, API keys (if user has access), and metadata.

## Create an environment

<a id="opIdEnvironmentsControllerV1_createEnvironment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Production Environment",
    "parentId": "60d5ecb8b3b3a30015f3e1a1",
    "color": "#3498db"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/environments`

Creates a new environment within the current organization. 
    Environments allow you to manage different stages of your application development lifecycle.
    Each environment has its own set of API keys and configurations.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "Production Environment",
  "parentId": "60d5ecb8b3b3a30015f3e1a1",
  "color": "#3498db"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-environment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateEnvironmentRequestDto](#schemacreateenvironmentrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the environment to be created|
|» parentId|body|string|false|MongoDB ObjectId of the parent environment (optional)|
|» color|body|string|true|Hex color code for the environment|

## Update an environment

<a id="opIdEnvironmentsControllerV1_updateMyEnvironment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environments/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "identifier": "string",
    "parentId": "string",
    "color": "string",
    "dns": {
      "inboundParseDomain": "string"
    },
    "bridge": {
      "url": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/environments/{environmentId}`

Update an environment by its unique identifier **environmentId**. 
    You can modify the environment name, identifier, color, and other configuration settings.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "identifier": "string",
  "parentId": "string",
  "color": "string",
  "dns": {
    "inboundParseDomain": "string"
  },
  "bridge": {
    "url": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-environment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|environmentId|path|string|true|The unique identifier of the environment|
|body|body|[UpdateEnvironmentRequestDto](#schemaupdateenvironmentrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» identifier|body|string|false|none|
|» parentId|body|string|false|none|
|» color|body|string|false|none|
|» dns|body|[InBoundParseDomainDto](#schemainboundparsedomaindto)|false|none|
|» bridge|body|[BridgeConfigurationDto](#schemabridgeconfigurationdto)|false|none|

## Delete an environment

<a id="opIdEnvironmentsControllerV1_deleteEnvironment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environments/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/environments/{environmentId}`

Delete an environment by its unique identifier **environmentId**. 
    This action is irreversible and will remove the environment and all its associated data.

<h3 id="delete-an-environment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|environmentId|path|string|true|The unique identifier of the environment|

## List environment tags

<a id="opIdEnvironmentsController_getEnvironmentTags"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/environments/6615943e7ace93b0540ae377/tags \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/environments/{environmentId}/tags`

Retrieve all unique tags used in workflows within the specified environment. These tags can be used for filtering workflows.

<h3 id="list-environment-tags-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|environmentId|path|string|true|Environment internal ID (MongoDB ObjectId) or identifier|

## Publish resources to target environment

<a id="opIdEnvironmentsController_publishEnvironment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/environments/6615943e7ace93b0540ae377/publish \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "sourceEnvironmentId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
    "dryRun": false,
    "resources": [
      {
        "resourceType": {},
        "resourceId": "workflow-id-1"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v2/environments/{targetEnvironmentId}/publish`

Publishes all workflows and resources from the development environment to the target environment. Optionally specify specific resources to publish or use dryRun mode to preview changes.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "sourceEnvironmentId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
  "dryRun": false,
  "resources": [
    {
      "resourceType": {},
      "resourceId": "workflow-id-1"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="publish-resources-to-target-environment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|targetEnvironmentId|path|string|true|Target environment ID (MongoDB ObjectId) to publish resources to|
|body|body|[PublishEnvironmentRequestDto](#schemapublishenvironmentrequestdto)|true|Publish request configuration|
|» sourceEnvironmentId|body|string|false|Source environment ID. Only the Development environment is currently supported; defaults to Development if omitted.|
|» dryRun|body|boolean|false|Perform a dry run without making actual changes|
|» resources|body|[[ResourceToPublishDto](#schemaresourcetopublishdto)]|false|Array of specific resources to publish. If not provided, all resources will be published.|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "data": {
    "results": [
      {
        "resourceType": {},
        "successful": [
          {
            "resourceType": {},
            "resourceId": "string",
            "resourceName": "string",
            "action": {}
          }
        ],
        "failed": [
          {
            "resourceType": {},

            "resourceName": "string",

            "stack": "string"

            "resourceId": "string",
            "resourceName": "string",
            "reason": "string"
          }
        ],
        "totalProcessed": 0
      }
    ],
    "summary": {
      "resources": 0,
      "successful": 0,
      "failed": 0,
      "skipped": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## Compare resources between environments

<a id="opIdEnvironmentsController_diffEnvironment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/environments/6615943e7ace93b0540ae377/diff \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "sourceEnvironmentId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/environments/{targetEnvironmentId}/diff`

Compares workflows and other resources between the development and target environments, returning detailed diff information including additions, modifications, and deletions.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "sourceEnvironmentId": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011"
}
```

<h3 id="compare-resources-between-environments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|targetEnvironmentId|path|string|true|Target environment ID (MongoDB ObjectId) to compare against|
|body|body|[DiffEnvironmentRequestDto](#schemadiffenvironmentrequestdto)|true|Diff request configuration|
|» sourceEnvironmentId|body|string|false|Source environment ID. Only the Development environment is currently supported; defaults to Development if omitted.|

<h1 id="novu-api-layouts">Layouts</h1>

Layouts are reusable wrappers for your email notifications.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/platform/workflow/layouts">External documentation</a>

## List all layouts

<a id="opIdLayoutsController_list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/layouts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/layouts`

Retrieves a list of layouts with optional filtering and pagination

<h3 id="list-all-layouts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|query|number|false|Number of items to return per page|
|offset|query|number|false|Number of items to skip before starting to return results|
|orderDirection|query|[DirectionEnum](#schemadirectionenum)|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|[LayoutResponseDtoSortField](#schemalayoutresponsedtosortfield)|false|Field to sort the results by|
|query|query|string|false|Search query to filter layouts|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|
|orderBy|createdAt|
|orderBy|updatedAt|
|orderBy|name|

## Create a layout

<a id="opIdLayoutsController_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/layouts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "layoutId": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "isTranslationEnabled": false,
    "__source": "dashboard"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/layouts`

Creates a new layout in the Novu Cloud environment

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "layoutId": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "isTranslationEnabled": false,
  "__source": "dashboard"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-layout-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateLayoutDto](#schemacreatelayoutdto)|true|Layout creation details|
|» layoutId|body|string|true|Unique identifier for the layout|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the layout|
|» isTranslationEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable translations for this layout|
|» __source|body|object|false|Source of layout creation|

## Update a layout

<a id="opIdLayoutsController_update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/layouts/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "isTranslationEnabled": false,
    "controlValues": {
      "email": {
        "body": "string",
        "editorType": "html"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /v2/layouts/{layoutId}`

Updates the details of an existing layout, here **layoutId** is the identifier of the layout

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "isTranslationEnabled": false,
  "controlValues": {
    "email": {
      "body": "string",
      "editorType": "html"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-layout-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|layoutId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateLayoutDto](#schemaupdatelayoutdto)|true|Layout update details|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the layout|
|» isTranslationEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable translations for this layout|
|» controlValues|body|object \| null|false|Control values for the layout. Omit to leave unchanged, or set to null to clear stored control values.|
|» » email|body|object|false|Email layout controls|
|» » » body|body|string|true|Body of the layout.|
|» » » editorType|body|string|true|Editor type of the layout.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » » editorType|html|
|» » » editorType|block|

## Duplicate a layout

<a id="opIdLayoutsController_duplicate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/layouts/string/duplicate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "layoutId": "string",
    "isTranslationEnabled": false
  }'
```

`POST /v2/layouts/{layoutId}/duplicate`

Duplicates a layout by its unique identifier **layoutId**. This will create a new layout with the content of the original layout.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "layoutId": "string",
  "isTranslationEnabled": false
}
```

<h3 id="duplicate-a-layout-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|layoutId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[DuplicateLayoutDto](#schemaduplicatelayoutdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the layout|
|» layoutId|body|string|false|Identifier for the duplicated layout. When omitted, it is derived from the name.|
|» isTranslationEnabled|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable translations for this layout|

`POST /v2/layouts/{layoutId}/preview`

Generates a preview for a layout by its unique identifier **layoutId**

```json
{

            ],

            "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.png",

          },
```

<h3 id="generate-layout-preview-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|layoutId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[LayoutPreviewRequestDto](#schemalayoutpreviewrequestdto)|true|Layout preview generation details|
|» controlValues|body|object|false|Optional control values for layout preview|
|» previewPayload|body|object|false|Optional payload for layout preview|
|» » subscriber|body|object|false|Partial subscriber information|
|» » » _id|body|string|false|The internal ID generated by Novu for your subscriber. This ID does not match the `subscriberId` used in your queries. Refer to `subscriberId` for that identifier.|
|» » » firstName|body|string \| null|false|The first name of the subscriber.|
|» » » lastName|body|string \| null|false|The last name of the subscriber.|
|» » » email|body|string \| null|false|The email address of the subscriber.|
|» » » phone|body|string \| null|false|The phone number of the subscriber.|
|» » » avatar|body|string \| null|false|The URL of the subscriber's avatar image.|
|» » » locale|body|string \| null|false|The locale setting of the subscriber, indicating their preferred language or region.|
|» » » channels|body|[[ChannelSettingsDto](#schemachannelsettingsdto)]|false|An array of channel settings associated with the subscriber.|
|» » » topics|body|[string]|false|**Deprecated.** An array of topics that the subscriber is subscribed to.|
|» » » isOnline|body|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether the subscriber is currently online.|
|» » » lastOnlineAt|body|string \| null|false|The timestamp indicating when the subscriber was last online, in ISO 8601 format.|
|» » » __v|body|number|false|The version of the subscriber document.|
|» » » data|body|object \| null|false|Additional custom data for the subscriber|
|» » » timezone|body|string \| null|false|Timezone of the subscriber|

<h1 id="novu-api-translations">Translations</h1>

Used to localize your notifications to different languages.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/platform/workflow/advanced-features/translations">External documentation</a>

## Upload translation files

<a id="opIdTranslationController_uploadTranslationFiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/translations/upload \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -F 'resourceId=welcome-email' \
  -F 'resourceType=workflow' \
  -F 'files=["string"]'
```

`POST /v2/translations/upload`

Upload one or more JSON translation files for a specific workflow. Files name must match the locale, e.g. en_US.json. Supports both "files" and "files[]" field names for backwards compatibility.

> Body parameter

```yaml
resourceId: welcome-email
resourceType: workflow
files:
  - string
```

<h3 id="upload-translation-files-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» resourceId|body|string|true|The resource ID to associate localizations with. Accepts identifier or slug format|
|» resourceType|body|string|true|The resource type to associate localizations with|
|» files|body|[string(binary)]|true|One or more JSON translation files. Filenames must match locale format (e.g., en_US.json, fr_FR.json). Field name can be "files" or "files[]".|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» resourceType|workflow|
|» resourceType|layout|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "totalFiles": 3,
  "successfulUploads": 2,
  "failedUploads": 1,
  "errors": [
    "Invalid JSON in file: es-ES.json"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="upload-translation-files-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Upload results|[UploadTranslationsResponseDto](#schemauploadtranslationsresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
secretKey, secretKey
</aside>

## Create a translation

<a id="opIdTranslationController_createTranslationEndpoint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/translations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "resourceId": "welcome-email",
    "resourceType": "workflow",
    "locale": "en_US",
    "content": {
      "welcome.title": "Welcome",
      "welcome.message": "Hello there!"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v2/translations`

Create a translation for a specific workflow and locale, if the translation already exists, it will be updated

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "resourceId": "welcome-email",
  "resourceType": "workflow",
  "locale": "en_US",
  "content": {
    "welcome.title": "Welcome",
    "welcome.message": "Hello there!"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-translation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateTranslationRequestDto](#schemacreatetranslationrequestdto)|true|none|
|» resourceId|body|string|true|The resource ID to associate translation with. Accepts identifier or slug format|
|» resourceType|body|string|true|The resource type to associate translation with|
|» locale|body|string|true|Locale code (e.g., en_US, es_ES)|
|» content|body|object|true|Translation content as JSON object|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» resourceType|workflow|
|» resourceType|layout|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "resourceId": "welcome-email",
  "resourceType": "workflow",
  "locale": "en_US",
  "content": {
    "welcome.title": "Welcome",
    "welcome.message": "Hello there!"
  },
  "createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-translation-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Translation created or updated successfully|[TranslationResponseDto](#schematranslationresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
secretKey, secretKey
</aside>

## Retrieve master translations JSON

<a id="opIdTranslationController_getMasterJsonEndpoint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/translations/master-json \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/translations/master-json`

Retrieve all translations for a locale in master JSON format organized by resourceId (workflowId)

<h3 id="retrieve-master-translations-json-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|locale|query|string|false|Locale to export. If not provided, exports organization default locale|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "workflows": {
    "welcome-email": {
      "welcome.title": "Welcome to our platform",
      "welcome.message": "Hello there!"
    },
    "password-reset": {
      "reset.title": "Reset your password",
      "reset.message": "Click the link to reset"
    }
  },
  "layouts": {
    "default-layout": {
      "layout.title": "Default layout",
      "layout.message": "Hello there!"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-master-translations-json-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Master translations JSON retrieved successfully|[GetMasterJsonResponseDto](#schemagetmasterjsonresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
secretKey, secretKey
</aside>

## Import master translations JSON

<a id="opIdTranslationController_importMasterJsonEndpoint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/translations/master-json \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "locale": "en_US",
    "masterJson": {
      "workflows": {
        "welcome-email": {
          "welcome.title": "Welcome to our platform",
          "welcome.message": "Hello there!"
        },
        "password-reset": {
          "reset.title": "Reset your password",
          "reset.message": "Click the link to reset"
        }
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v2/translations/master-json`

Import translations for multiple workflows from master JSON format for a specific locale

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "locale": "en_US",
  "masterJson": {
    "workflows": {
      "welcome-email": {
        "welcome.title": "Welcome to our platform",
        "welcome.message": "Hello there!"
      },
      "password-reset": {
        "reset.title": "Reset your password",
        "reset.message": "Click the link to reset"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="import-master-translations-json-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ImportMasterJsonRequestDto](#schemaimportmasterjsonrequestdto)|true|none|
|» locale|body|string|true|The locale for which translations are being imported|
|» masterJson|body|object|true|Master JSON object containing all translations organized by workflow identifier|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Successfully imported translations for 2 resources: welcome-email, password-reset",
  "successful": [
    "welcome-email",
    "password-reset"
  ],
  "failed": [
    "missing-workflow"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="import-master-translations-json-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Master translations imported successfully|[ImportMasterJsonResponseDto](#schemaimportmasterjsonresponsedto)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
secretKey, secretKey
</aside>

## Retrieve a translation

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/translations/workflow/welcome-email/en_US \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/translations/{resourceType}/{resourceId}/{locale}`

<h3 id="retrieve-a-translation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|

|resourceType|layout|

```json
  "content": {
    "welcome.title": "Welcome",
    "welcome.message": "Hello there!"
  },
```

<h1 id="novu-api-domains">Domains</h1>

Used to manage your inbound email domains.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/platform/domains">External documentation</a>

## List domains for an environment

<a id="opIdDomainsController_listDomains"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/domains`

Returns a paginated list of inbound-email domains in the current environment. Supports cursor pagination and a name contains filter.

<h3 id="list-domains-for-an-environment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|name|query|string|false|Domain name to filter results by.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create a domain

<a id="opIdDomainsController_createDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "data": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/domains`

Registers a new inbound-email domain. The response includes the DNS records customers must add at their DNS provider before the domain can receive mail.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "data": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateDomainDto](#schemacreatedomaindto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The domain name (e.g. "recent.dev")|
|» data|body|object|false|Optional string key-value metadata (max 10 keys, 500 characters total for keys+values).|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|

## Retrieve a domain by name

<a id="opIdDomainsController_getDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/domains/{domain}`

Returns the domain configuration and the DNS records that must be in place. This is a pure read; call `domains.verify` to refresh verification status from DNS.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-domain-by-name-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|

## Delete a domain

<a id="opIdDomainsController_deleteDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/domains/{domain}`

Removes the domain and cascades the deletion to all of its routes. Inbound mail for that domain stops being processed immediately.

<h3 id="delete-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|

## Update a domain

<a id="opIdDomainsController_updateDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "data": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/domains/{domain}`

Updates optional domain fields. When `data` is provided, it replaces the entire metadata object; omit `data` to leave it unchanged.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "data": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateDomainDto](#schemaupdatedomaindto)|true|none|
|» data|body|object|false|Replaces domain metadata when provided (max 10 keys, 500 characters total for keys+values).|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|

## Verify a domain

<a id="opIdDomainsController_verifyDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/verify \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /v1/domains/{domain}/verify`

Performs a live DNS lookup to refresh the MX record status of the domain and updates the verification status accordingly. Returns the latest domain configuration.

<h3 id="verify-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "_id": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "status": "pending",
    "mxRecordConfigured": true,
    "dnsProvider": "string",
    "_environmentId": "string",
    "_organizationId": "string",
    "createdAt": "string",
    "updatedAt": "string",
    "expectedDnsRecords": [
      {
        "type": "MX",
        "name": "inbound",
        "content": "inbound-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com",
        "ttl": "Auto",
        "priority": 10
      }
    ],
    "data": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

## Diagnose inbound DNS for a domain

<a id="opIdDomainsController_diagnoseDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/diagnose \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /v1/domains/{domain}/diagnose`

Runs live DNS checks for inbound email readiness (MX correctness, apex CNAME collision, and common DNS blocklists for the Novu mail host). Returns structured issues with plain-language fixes.

<h3 id="diagnose-inbound-dns-for-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "ok": true,
    "runAt": "string",
    "checks": [
      {
        "code": "mx_missing",
        "status": "pass",
        "latencyMs": 0
      }
    ],
    "issues": [
      {
        "code": "mx_missing",
        "severity": "warn",
        "message": "string",
        "fix": "string"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## List routes for a domain

<a id="opIdDomainsController_listDomainRoutes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/routes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/domains/{domain}/routes`

Returns a paginated list of routes attached to the domain. Optionally filter by an agent identifier to find routes pointing to a specific agent.

<h3 id="list-routes-for-a-domain-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|agentId|query|string|false|Agent identifier to filter routes by.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create a route

<a id="opIdDomainsController_createDomainRoute"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/routes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "address": "string",
    "agentId": "string",
    "type": "agent",
    "data": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/domains/{domain}/routes`

Creates a route on the domain that forwards inbound mail addressed to `<address>@<domain>` to either a webhook or an agent. Each address on a domain may only have a single route.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "address": "string",
  "agentId": "string",
  "type": "agent",
  "data": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-route-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[DomainRouteDto](#schemadomainroutedto)|true|none|
|» address|body|string|true|Inbox address local part (e.g. "support", "*")|
|» agentId|body|string|false|Agent identifier; required when type is agent, unused for webhook|
|» type|body|string|true|none|
|» data|body|object|false|Optional string key-value metadata (max 10 keys, 500 characters total for keys+values).|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|agent|
|» type|webhook|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "_id": "string",
    "_domainId": "string",
    "address": "string",
    "agentId": "string",
    "type": "agent",
    "_environmentId": "string",
    "_organizationId": "string",
    "createdAt": "string",
    "updatedAt": "string",
    "data": {

      "property2": "string"

}
```

## Retrieve a route by address

<a id="opIdDomainsController_getDomainRoute"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/routes/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/domains/{domain}/routes/{address}`

Returns the route bound to `<address>@<domain>`. Use `*` as the address to retrieve the wildcard route for the domain.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-route-by-address-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|
|address|path|string|true|none|

## Delete a route

<a id="opIdDomainsController_deleteDomainRoute"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/routes/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/domains/{domain}/routes/{address}`

Removes the route bound to `<address>@<domain>`. Inbound mail for that address will no longer be processed.

<h3 id="delete-a-route-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|
|address|path|string|true|none|

## Update a route

<a id="opIdDomainsController_updateDomainRoute"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/routes/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "agentId": "string",
    "type": "agent",
    "data": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/domains/{domain}/routes/{address}`

Updates the destination of the route bound to `<address>@<domain>`. The address itself is the resource identity and cannot be changed; delete and recreate the route to rename it.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "agentId": "string",
  "type": "agent",
  "data": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-route-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

## Test an inbound route

<a id="opIdDomainsController_testDomainRoute"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/routes/string/test \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "from": {
      "address": "user@example.com",
      "name": "string"
    },
    "subject": "string",
    "text": "string",
    "html": "string",
    "dryRun": true
  }'
```

`POST /v1/domains/{domain}/routes/{address}/test`

Sends a synthetic inbound email through the same delivery path as production (outbound webhooks for webhook routes, signed HTTP to the agent for agent routes). Use `dryRun: true` to preview the payload without delivering.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "from": {
    "address": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "subject": "string",
  "text": "string",
  "html": "string",
  "dryRun": true
}
```

<h3 id="test-an-inbound-route-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|
|address|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[TestDomainRouteDto](#schematestdomainroutedto)|true|none|
|» from|body|[TestDomainRouteFromDto](#schematestdomainroutefromdto)|true|none|
|» subject|body|string|true|none|
|» text|body|string|false|none|
|» html|body|string|false|none|
|» dryRun|body|boolean|false|When true, returns the payload that would be delivered without invoking outbound webhooks or the agent HTTP endpoint.|

```json
    "matched": true,

    },

    }

}
```

## Retrieve auto-configuration availability

<a id="opIdDomainsController_getDomainAutoConfigure"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/auto-configure \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/domains/{domain}/auto-configure`

Returns whether DNS auto-configuration (Domain Connect) is available for this domain. When `available` is `false`, `manualRecords` lists the DNS records the customer must add manually.

<h3 id="retrieve-auto-configuration-availability-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "available": true,
    "providerName": "string",
    "providerId": "string",
    "reason": "string",
    "reasonCode": "disabled",
    "manualRecords": [
      {
        "type": "MX",
        "name": "inbound",
        "content": "inbound-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com",
        "ttl": "Auto",
        "priority": 10
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Start DNS auto-configuration

<a id="opIdDomainsController_startDomainAutoConfigure"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/domains/string/auto-configure/start \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "redirectUri": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/domains/{domain}/auto-configure/start`

Generates a signed redirect URL the customer can follow to apply Novu DNS records at their DNS provider. After the provider completes the flow, it redirects back to `redirectUri`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "redirectUri": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="start-dns-auto-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domain|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[CreateDomainConnectApplyUrlDto](#schemacreatedomainconnectapplyurldto)|true|none|
|» redirectUri|body|string|false|Dashboard URL to return to after the DNS provider consent flow completes.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "applyUrl": "string",
    "providerName": "string",
    "redirectUri": "string"
  }
}
```

<h1 id="novu-api-agents">Agents</h1>

Agents are conversational assistants that receive inbound messages from connected channels and respond through a custom code bridge or a managed runtime provider.

<a href="https://docs.novu.co/agents">External documentation</a>

## List all agents

<a id="opIdAgentsController_listAgents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/agents`

Retrieve a cursor-paginated list of agents for the current environment. Use **after**, **before**, **limit**, **orderBy**, and **orderDirection** query parameters.

<h3 id="list-all-agents-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|identifier|query|string|false|Filter agents by partial, case-insensitive match on identifier.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create an agent

<a id="opIdAgentsController_createAgent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Novu-Analytics-Source: string' \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "identifier": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "active": true,
    "runtime": "self-hosted",
    "managedRuntime": {
      "providerId": "anthropic",
      "integrationId": "string",
      "externalAgentId": "string",
      "externalEnvironmentId": "string",
      "model": "string",
      "systemPrompt": "string",
      "tools": [
        "string"
      ],
      "mcpServers": [
        "string"
      ],
      "skills": [
        {
          "type": "anthropic",
          "skillId": "string",
          "version": {}
        }
      ]
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/agents`

Create an agent scoped to the current environment. The identifier must be unique per environment. Set `runtime` to `managed` and supply `managedRuntime` to provision a provider-hosted agent brain.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "identifier": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "active": true,
  "runtime": "self-hosted",
  "managedRuntime": {
    "providerId": "anthropic",
    "integrationId": "string",
    "externalAgentId": "string",
    "externalEnvironmentId": "string",
    "model": "string",
    "systemPrompt": "string",
    "tools": [
      "string"
    ],
    "mcpServers": [
      "string"
    ],
    "skills": [
      {
        "type": "anthropic",
        "skillId": "string",
        "version": {}
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Novu-Analytics-Source|header|string|true|none|
|body|body|[CreateAgentRequestDto](#schemacreateagentrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Required when not adopting an existing managed agent (i.e. when managedRuntime.externalAgentId is absent). Optional in adopt mode where the name is resolved from the provider.|
|» identifier|body|string|true|Required when not adopting an existing managed agent. Auto-generated from the provider agent name when omitted in adopt mode.|
|» description|body|string|false|none|
|» active|body|boolean|false|none|
|» runtime|body|string|false|none|
|» managedRuntime|body|[ManagedRuntimeDto](#schemamanagedruntimedto)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» runtime|self-hosted|
|» runtime|managed|

## Update an agent bridge

<a id="opIdAgentsController_updateAgentBridge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents/string/bridge \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "bridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
    "devBridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
    "devBridgeActive": true
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/agents/{identifier}/bridge`

Update the bridge URL configuration for an agent. Used by the CLI to register dev tunnel URLs. Refuses to activate dev bridges on production environments.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
  "devBridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
  "devBridgeActive": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-agent-bridge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateAgentBridgeRequestDto](#schemaupdateagentbridgerequestdto)|true|none|
|» bridgeUrl|body|string(uri)|false|Production bridge URL for this agent|
|» devBridgeUrl|body|string(uri)|false|Development bridge URL (set by npx novu dev)|
|» devBridgeActive|body|boolean|false|Whether the dev bridge override is active|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "_id": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "identifier": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "behavior": {
```

## Delete an agent

<a id="opIdAgentsController_deleteAgent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.novu.co/v1/agents/string?deleteFromProvider=string' \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/agents/{identifier}`

Delete an agent by identifier, remove all agent-integration links, and clear the agent assignment from any workflows that reference it. For managed-runtime agents, pass `deleteFromProvider=true` to also archive the agent on the provider side (e.g. Anthropic). By default only the Novu record is deleted and the provider agent is left intact.

<h3 id="delete-an-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|none|
|deleteFromProvider|query|string|true|none|
