## Update an agent

<a id="opIdAgentsController_updateAgent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "active": true,
    "behavior": {
      "acknowledgeOnReceived": true,
      "reactionOnResolved": "check",
      "subscriberAccess": "open",
      "replyPolicy": "auto_reply"
    },
    "bridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
    "devBridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
    "devBridgeActive": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/agents/{identifier}`

Update an agent by its external identifier.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "active": true,
  "behavior": {
    "acknowledgeOnReceived": true,
    "reactionOnResolved": "check",
    "subscriberAccess": "open",
    "replyPolicy": "auto_reply"
  },
  "bridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
  "devBridgeUrl": "http://example.com",
  "devBridgeActive": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-agent-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateAgentRequestDto](#schemaupdateagentrequestdto)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|none|
|» active|body|boolean|false|none|
|» behavior|body|[AgentBehaviorDto](#schemaagentbehaviordto)|false|none|
|» bridgeUrl|body|string(uri)|false|Production bridge URL for this agent|
|» devBridgeUrl|body|string(uri)|false|Development bridge URL (set by npx novu dev)|
|» devBridgeActive|body|boolean|false|Whether the dev bridge override is active|

## List agent integrations

<a id="opIdAgentIntegrationsController_listAgentIntegrations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents/string/integrations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/agents/{identifier}/integrations`

Retrieve integration links for an agent identified by its external identifier. Supports cursor pagination via **after**, **before**, **limit**, **orderBy**, and **orderDirection**.

<h3 id="list-agent-integrations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|none|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|integrationIdentifier|query|string|false|Return only links for this integration identifier (not the internal document _id).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create an agent integration

<a id="opIdAgentIntegrationsController_addAgentIntegration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents/string/integrations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -H 'Novu-Analytics-Source: string' \
  -d '{
    "integrationIdentifier": "string",
    "providerId": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/agents/{identifier}/integrations`

Create a link between an agent (by identifier) and an integration (by integration **identifier**, not the internal _id).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "providerId": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-agent-integration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|none|
|Novu-Analytics-Source|header|string|true|none|
|body|body|[AddAgentIntegrationRequestDto](#schemaaddagentintegrationrequestdto)|true|none|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|false|The integration identifier (same as in the integration store), not the internal document _id.|
|» providerId|body|string|false|Provider ID to auto-create a dedicated integration (e.g. novu-agent-email). When set, the server creates the integration if one does not already exist for this agent.|

## Update an agent integration

<a id="opIdAgentIntegrationsController_updateAgentIntegration"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents/string/integrations/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "integrationIdentifier": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/agents/{identifier}/integrations/{agentIntegrationId}`

Update which integration a link points to (by integration **identifier**, not the internal _id).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "integrationIdentifier": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-agent-integration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|none|
|agentIntegrationId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[UpdateAgentIntegrationRequestDto](#schemaupdateagentintegrationrequestdto)|true|none|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|true|The integration identifier this link should point to (not the internal document _id).|

## Send an agent reply

<a id="opIdAgentReplyController_handleAgentReplyHandler"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/agents/support-agent/reply \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "conversationId": "64f5a1c2e8b7a3d9f0c1b2a3",
    "integrationIdentifier": "slack-support",
    "reply": {
      "markdown": "**Report ready.** Your weekly summary is attached."
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/agents/{agentId}/reply`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

**Deprecated** — use `POST /v1/agents/events/ingest` (AgentEvent protocol).
This route stays live for old `@novu/framework` and existing OpenAPI `sendReply` clients.
Do not use it for new integrations.

**Message actions**
- `reply` — markdown, interactive card, or tool-approval card (optional `files`)
- `edit` — update a previously delivered message in place
- `deleteMessages` — remove rendered platform messages (history is kept)
- `addReactions` — add emoji reactions to existing messages

**Turn control**
- `typing` — `{ status?: string }` to set status, or `"stop"` to clear
- `resolve` — mark the conversation resolved (optionally with a final reply)
- `error: true` — report a customer-runtime failure (cannot combine with other actions)

**Signals & tools**
- `signals` — metadata set/delete/clear, or trigger a Novu workflow
- `toolResults` — persist tool outputs into conversation history
- `toolApprovalRequest` — ledger a gated tool call (pair with an approval card reply)

Returns `{ data: { messageId, platformThreadId } }` when a reply or edit is delivered;
otherwise `{ data: null }`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "conversationId": "64f5a1c2e8b7a3d9f0c1b2a3",
  "integrationIdentifier": "slack-support",
  "reply": {
    "markdown": "**Report ready.** Your weekly summary is attached."
  }
}
```

<h3 id="send-an-agent-reply-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agentId|path|string|true|Agent identifier (slug) for the agent that owns the conversation.|
|body|body|[AgentReplyPayloadDto](#schemaagentreplypayloaddto)|true|Reply payload. Provide at least one action: `reply`, `edit`, `resolve`, `signals`, `toolResults`, `toolApprovalRequest`, `addReactions`, `deleteMessages`, `typing`, or `error`. See named examples for common shapes used by server-side SDKs.|
|» conversationId|body|string|true|Conversation id to reply into. Obtained from the inbound agent event / bridge payload.|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|true|Channel integration identifier linked to the agent for this conversation (e.g. `slack-support`).|
|» reply|body|[MarkdownReplyContentDto](#schemamarkdownreplycontentdto) \| [CardReplyContentDto](#schemacardreplycontentdto) \| [ToolApprovalCardReplyContentDto](#schematoolapprovalcardreplycontentdto)|false|Outbound message content. Exactly one of `markdown`, `card`, or `toolApprovalCard`. Optional `files` attach to the message. Cannot be combined with `edit`.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[MarkdownReplyContentDto](#schemamarkdownreplycontentdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[CardReplyContentDto](#schemacardreplycontentdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ToolApprovalCardReplyContentDto](#schematoolapprovalcardreplycontentdto)|false|none|
|» toolApprovalRequest|body|object|false|Tool-lifecycle ledger row for a gated tool call. Pair with `reply.toolApprovalCard` (or another reply shape) to deliver the approval UI.|
|» » approvalId|body|string|true|Unique id for this approval request (matches the AI SDK approvalId).|
|» » toolCallId|body|string|true|Id of the tool call awaiting approval.|
|» » name|body|string|true|Name of the gated tool.|
|» » input|body|object|false|Tool input the model proposed.|
|» » approveActionId|body|string|false|Server-minted approve action id. When omitted, self-hosted tool-approval:* is minted at persist.|
|» » denyActionId|body|string|false|Server-minted deny action id. When omitted, self-hosted tool-approval:* is minted at persist.|
|» » mcpServerName|body|string|false|MCP server name when the gated tool is from an MCP server (for UI labels).|
|» » to|body|object|false|Novu subscriberId(s) allowed to settle this tool gate when HITL is enabled.|
|» » from|body|string|false|Attribution label shown on the HITL card.|
|» » ttlSeconds|body|number|false|Seconds until the HITL tool-gate expires.|
|» edit|body|object|false|In-place edit of a previously posted agent message. Cannot be combined with reply, resolve, signals, toolResults, toolApprovalRequest, addReactions, or deleteMessages.|
|» » messageId|body|string|true|Platform message id of the message to edit.|
|» » content|body|[MarkdownReplyContentDto](#schemamarkdownreplycontentdto) \| [CardReplyContentDto](#schemacardreplycontentdto) \| [ToolApprovalCardReplyContentDto](#schematoolapprovalcardreplycontentdto)|true|Replacement content. Exactly one of markdown, card, or toolApprovalCard.|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[MarkdownReplyContentDto](#schemamarkdownreplycontentdto)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[CardReplyContentDto](#schemacardreplycontentdto)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[ToolApprovalCardReplyContentDto](#schematoolapprovalcardreplycontentdto)|false|none|
|» resolve|body|object|false|Mark the conversation resolved. May be combined with a final `reply`.|
|» » summary|body|string|false|Optional human-readable resolution summary stored on the conversation.|
|» signals|body|[[MetadataSetSignalDto](#schemametadatasetsignaldto) \| [MetadataDeleteSignalDto](#schemametadatadeletesignaldto) \| [MetadataClearSignalDto](#schemametadataclearsignaldto) \| [TriggerSignalDto](#schematriggersignaldto) \| [HumanSignalDto](#schemahumansignaldto)]|false|Side-effect signals executed during this turn: conversation metadata mutations, Novu workflow triggers, or human-in-the-loop interactions.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[MetadataSetSignalDto](#schemametadatasetsignaldto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[MetadataDeleteSignalDto](#schemametadatadeletesignaldto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[MetadataClearSignalDto](#schemametadataclearsignaldto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[TriggerSignalDto](#schematriggersignaldto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[HumanSignalDto](#schemahumansignaldto)|false|none|
|» toolResults|body|[[ToolResultDto](#schematoolresultdto)]|false|Tool-call outcomes to persist in conversation history (typically before the assistant reply).|
|» addReactions|body|[[AddReactionPayloadDto](#schemaaddreactionpayloaddto)]|false|Emoji reactions to add to existing platform messages.|
|» deleteMessages|body|[[DeleteMessagePayloadDto](#schemadeletemessagepayloaddto)]|false|Delete previously posted platform messages. Removes the rendered message only — history is preserved.|
|» typing|body|string \| [TypingStatusDto](#schematypingstatusdto)|false|Per-turn typing/status control. Pass `{ status?: string }` to set/update the status (omit `status` for "Thinking…"), or `"stop"` to clear it. Best-effort per platform.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Clear the typing indicator.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[TypingStatusDto](#schematypingstatusdto)|false|none|
|» error|body|boolean|false|Bridge reports that the customer runtime failed this turn. Cannot be combined with other actions. Novu delivers generic user-facing error copy.|

<h1 id="novu-api-notifications">Notifications</h1>

## List all events

<a id="opIdNotificationsController_listNotifications"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/notifications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/notifications`

List all notification events (triggered events) for the current environment. 
    This API supports filtering by **channels**, **templates**, **emails**, **subscriberIds**, **transactionId**, **topicKey**, **severity**, **contextKeys**. 
    Checkout all available filters in the query section.
    This API returns event triggers, to list each channel notifications, check messages APIs.

<h3 id="list-all-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channels|query|[[ChannelTypeEnum](#schemachanneltypeenum)]|false|Array of channel types|
|templates|query|[string]|false|Array of template IDs or a single template ID|
|emails|query|[string]|false|Array of email addresses or a single email address|
|search|query|string|false|**Deprecated.** Search term (deprecated)|
|subscriberIds|query|[string]|false|Array of subscriber IDs or a single subscriber ID|
|severity|query|[string]|false|Array of severity levels or a single severity level|
|page|query|number|false|Page number for pagination|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit for pagination|
|transactionId|query|string|false|The transaction ID to filter by|
|topicKey|query|string|false|Topic Key for filtering notifications by topic|
|subscriptionId|query|string|false|Subscription ID for filtering notifications by subscription|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Filter by exact context keys, order insensitive (format: "type:id")|
|after|query|string|false|Date filter for records after this timestamp. Defaults to earliest date allowed by subscription plan|
|before|query|string|false|Date filter for records before this timestamp. Defaults to current time of request (now)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|channels|in_app|
|channels|email|
|channels|sms|
|channels|chat|
|channels|push|
|channels|tool|

## Retrieve an event

<a id="opIdNotificationsController_getNotification"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/notifications/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/notifications/{notificationId}`

Retrieve an event by its unique key identifier **notificationId**. 
    Here **notificationId** is of mongodbId type. 
    This API returns the event details - execution logs, status, actual notification (message) generated by each workflow step.

<h3 id="retrieve-an-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|notificationId|path|string|true|none|

<h1 id="novu-api-contexts">Contexts</h1>

## List all contexts

<a id="opIdContextsController_listContexts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/contexts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/contexts`

Retrieve a paginated list of all contexts, optionally filtered by type and key pattern.
      **type** and **id** are optional fields, if provided, only contexts with the matching type and id will be returned.
      **search** is an optional field, if provided, only contexts with the matching key pattern will be returned.
      Checkout all possible parameters in the query section below for more details

<h3 id="list-all-contexts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|type|query|string|false|Filter contexts by type|
|id|query|string|false|Filter contexts by id|
|search|query|string|false|Search contexts by type or id (supports partial matching across both fields)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderDirection|ASC|
|orderDirection|DESC|

## Create a context

<a id="opIdContextsController_createContext"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/contexts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "type": "tenant",
    "id": "org-acme",
    "data": {
      "tenantName": "Acme Corp",
      "region": "us-east-1",
      "settings": {
        "theme": "dark"
      }
    },
    "bridgeUrl": "https://tenant-acme.example.com/api/novu"
  }'
```

`POST /v2/contexts`

Create a new context with the specified type, id, and data. Returns 409 if context already exists.
      **type** and **id** are required fields, **data** is optional, if the context already exists, it returns the 409 response

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "type": "tenant",
  "id": "org-acme",
  "data": {
    "tenantName": "Acme Corp",
    "region": "us-east-1",
    "settings": {
      "theme": "dark"
    }
  },
  "bridgeUrl": "https://tenant-acme.example.com/api/novu"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateContextRequestDto](#schemacreatecontextrequestdto)|true|none|
|» type|body|string|true|Context type (e.g., tenant, app, workspace). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional separators.|
|» id|body|string|true|Unique identifier for this context. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional separators.|
|» data|body|object|false|Optional custom data to associate with this context.|
|» bridgeUrl|body|string(uri)|false|Optional bridge URL override for agent connect. When an inbound agent turn resolves this context, its bridge call is routed here instead of the agent default bridge URL. Must be a publicly reachable URL.|

## Retrieve a context

<a id="opIdContextsController_getContext"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/contexts/string/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v2/contexts/{type}/{id}`

Retrieve a specific context by its type and id.
      **type** and **id** are required fields, if the context does not exist, it returns the 404 response

<h3 id="retrieve-a-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Context ID|
|type|path|string|true|Context type|

## Delete a context

<a id="opIdContextsController_deleteContext"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/contexts/string/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v2/contexts/{type}/{id}`

Delete a context by its type and id.
      **type** and **id** are required fields, if the context does not exist, it returns the 404 response

<h3 id="delete-a-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Context ID|
|type|path|string|true|Context type|

## Update a context

<a id="opIdContextsController_updateContext"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v2/contexts/string/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "data": {
      "tenantName": "Acme Corp",
      "region": "us-east-1",
      "settings": {
        "theme": "dark"
      }
    },
    "bridgeUrl": "https://tenant-acme.example.com/api/novu"
  }'
```

`PATCH /v2/contexts/{type}/{id}`

Update the data of an existing context.
      **type** and **id** are required fields, **data** is required. Only the data field is updated, the rest of the context is not affected.
      If the context does not exist, it returns the 404 response

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "data": {
    "tenantName": "Acme Corp",
    "region": "us-east-1",
    "settings": {
      "theme": "dark"
    }
  },
  "bridgeUrl": "https://tenant-acme.example.com/api/novu"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Context ID|
|type|path|string|true|Context type|
|body|body|[UpdateContextRequestDto](#schemaupdatecontextrequestdto)|true|none|
|» data|body|object|true|Custom data to associate with this context. Replaces existing data.|
|» bridgeUrl|body|string(uri) \| null|false|Optional bridge URL override for agent connect. When an inbound agent turn resolves this context, its bridge call is routed here instead of the agent default bridge URL. Must be a publicly reachable URL. Pass null to clear an existing override.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "type": "string",
    "id": "string",
    "data": {},
    "bridgeUrl": "string",
    "createdAt": "string",
    "updatedAt": "string"
  }
}
```

<h1 id="novu-api-environment-variables">Environment Variables</h1>

## List all variables

<a id="opIdEnvironmentVariablesController_listEnvironmentVariables"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environment-variables \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/environment-variables`

Returns all environment variables for the current organization. Secret values are masked.

<h3 id="list-all-variables-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|search|query|string|false|Filter variables by key (case-insensitive partial match)|

```json
  "data": [

      "_organizationId": "string",
      "key": "string",
      "type": "string",

      "values": [
        {
          "_environmentId": "string",
          "value": "string"
        }
      ],
      "createdAt": "string",
      "updatedAt": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Create a variable

<a id="opIdEnvironmentVariablesController_createEnvironmentVariable"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environment-variables \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "string",
    "type": "string",
    "isSecret": true,
    "values": [
      {
        "_environmentId": "string",
        "value": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v1/environment-variables`

Creates a new environment variable. Keys must be uppercase with underscores only (e.g. BASE_URL). Secret variables are encrypted at rest and masked in API responses.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "key": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "isSecret": true,
  "values": [
    {
      "_environmentId": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-variable-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateEnvironmentVariableRequestDto](#schemacreateenvironmentvariablerequestdto)|true|none|
|» key|body|string|true|Unique key for the variable. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, and underscores.|
|» type|body|string|false|The type of the variable|
|» isSecret|body|boolean|false|Whether this variable is a secret (encrypted at rest, masked in responses)|
|» values|body|[[EnvironmentVariableValueDto](#schemaenvironmentvariablevaluedto)]|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|string|

```json
  "data": {

    "type": "string",

}
```

## Retrieve a variable usage

<a id="opIdEnvironmentVariablesController_getEnvironmentVariableUsage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environment-variables/BASE_URL/usage \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/environment-variables/{variableKey}/usage`

Returns the workflows that reference this environment variable via `{{env.KEY}}` in their step controls. **variableId** is required.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-variable-usage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|variableKey|path|string|true|The unique key of the environment variable (e.g. BASE_URL)|

## Get environment variable

<a id="opIdEnvironmentVariablesController_getEnvironmentVariable"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environment-variables/BASE_URL \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/environment-variables/{variableKey}`

Returns a single environment variable by key. Secret values are masked.

<h3 id="get-environment-variable-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|variableKey|path|string|true|The unique key of the environment variable (e.g. BASE_URL)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "_id": "string",
    "_organizationId": "string",
    "key": "string",
    "type": "string",
    "isSecret": true,
    "values": [
      {
        "_environmentId": "string",
        "value": "string"
      }
    ],
    "createdAt": "string",
    "updatedAt": "string"
  }
}
```

## Delete environment variable

<a id="opIdEnvironmentVariablesController_deleteEnvironmentVariable"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environment-variables/BASE_URL \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /v1/environment-variables/{variableKey}`

Deletes an environment variable by key.

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
secretKey
</aside>

## Update a variable

<a id="opIdEnvironmentVariablesController_updateEnvironmentVariable"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/environment-variables/BASE_URL \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "string",
    "type": "string",
    "isSecret": true,
    "values": [
      {
        "_environmentId": "string",
        "value": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/environment-variables/{variableKey}`

Updates an existing environment variable. Providing `values` merges them into the existing per-environment values by `_environmentId`; envs not present in the request keep their stored value. Submitting the masked secret placeholder (the value returned by read endpoints for secret variables) as a real value is rejected.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "key": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "isSecret": true,
  "values": [
    {
      "_environmentId": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-variable-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|variableKey|path|string|true|The unique key of the environment variable (e.g. BASE_URL)|
|body|body|[UpdateEnvironmentVariableRequestDto](#schemaupdateenvironmentvariablerequestdto)|true|none|
|» key|body|string|false|Unique key for the variable. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, and underscores.|
|» type|body|string|false|The type of the variable|
|» isSecret|body|boolean|false|none|
|» values|body|[[EnvironmentVariableValueDto](#schemaenvironmentvariablevaluedto)]|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|string|

```json
  "data": {

    "_organizationId": "string",
    "key": "string",
    "type": "string",
    "isSecret": true,
    "values": [
      {
        "_environmentId": "string",
        "value": "string"
      }
    ],
    "createdAt": "string",
    "updatedAt": "string"
  }
}
```

<h1 id="novu-api-channel-connections">Channel Connections</h1>

## List all channel connections

<a id="opIdChannelConnectionsController_listChannelConnections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/channel-connections \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/channel-connections`

List all channel connections for a resource.

<h3 id="list-all-channel-connections-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return (max 100)|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|subscriberId|query|string|false|The subscriber ID to filter results by|
|connectionMode|query|string|false|Scope results relative to the subscriber. `subscriber` returns only the subscriber-owned connections, `shared` returns only shared (workspace-level) connections. Omit to return both.|
|channel|query|string|false|Filter by channel type (email, sms, push, chat, etc.).|
|providerId|query|[ProvidersIdEnum](#schemaprovidersidenum)|false|Filter by provider identifier (e.g., sendgrid, twilio, slack, etc.).|
|integrationIdentifier|query|string|false|Filter by integration identifier.|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Filter by exact context keys, order insensitive (format: "type:id")|

## Create a channel connection

<a id="opIdChannelConnectionsController_createChannelConnection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/channel-connections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "identifier": "slack-prod-user123-abc4",
    "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    },
    "connectionMode": "shared",
    "integrationIdentifier": "slack-prod",
    "workspace": {
      "id": "T123456",
      "name": "Acme HQ",
      "botUserId": "U0123456789"
    },
    "auth": {
      "accessToken": "Workspace access token",
      "refreshToken": "Workspace refresh token",
      "expiresAt": "2026-06-15T12:00:00.000Z",
      "refreshTokenExpiresAt": "2026-09-15T12:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/channel-connections`

Create a new channel connection for a resource for given integration. Only one channel connection is allowed per resource and integration.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "identifier": "slack-prod-user123-abc4",
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "connectionMode": "shared",
  "integrationIdentifier": "slack-prod",
  "workspace": {
    "id": "T123456",
    "name": "Acme HQ",
    "botUserId": "U0123456789"
  },
  "auth": {
    "accessToken": "Workspace access token",
    "refreshToken": "Workspace refresh token",
    "expiresAt": "2026-06-15T12:00:00.000Z",
    "refreshTokenExpiresAt": "2026-09-15T12:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-channel-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateChannelConnectionRequestDto](#schemacreatechannelconnectionrequestdto)|true|none|
|» identifier|body|string|false|The unique identifier for the channel connection. If not provided, one will be generated automatically.|
|» subscriberId|body|string|false|The subscriber ID to link the channel connection to|
|» context|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string \| object|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|Simple context id|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|object|false|Rich context object with id and optional data|
|» » » id|body|string|true|none|
|» » » data|body|object|false|Optional additional context data|
|» connectionMode|body|string|false|Connection mode that determines how the channel connection is scoped. Use "subscriber" (default) to associate the connection with a specific subscriber. Use "shared" to associate the connection with a context instead of a subscriber — subscriberId will not be stored on the connection.|
|» integrationIdentifier|body|string|true|The identifier of the integration to use for this channel connection.|
|» workspace|body|[WorkspaceDto](#schemaworkspacedto)|true|none|
|» auth|body|[AuthDto](#schemaauthdto)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» connectionMode|subscriber|
|» connectionMode|shared|

## Update a channel connection

<a id="opIdChannelConnectionsController_updateChannelConnection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/channel-connections/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "workspace": {
      "id": "T123456",
      "name": "Acme HQ",
      "botUserId": "U0123456789"
    },
    "auth": {
      "accessToken": "Workspace access token",
      "refreshToken": "Workspace refresh token",
      "expiresAt": "2026-06-15T12:00:00.000Z",
      "refreshTokenExpiresAt": "2026-09-15T12:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/channel-connections/{identifier}`

Update an existing channel connection by its unique identifier.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "workspace": {
    "id": "T123456",
    "name": "Acme HQ",
    "botUserId": "U0123456789"
  },
  "auth": {
    "accessToken": "Workspace access token",
    "refreshToken": "Workspace refresh token",
    "expiresAt": "2026-06-15T12:00:00.000Z",
    "refreshTokenExpiresAt": "2026-09-15T12:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-channel-connection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|The unique identifier of the channel connection|
|body|body|[UpdateChannelConnectionRequestDto](#schemaupdatechannelconnectionrequestdto)|true|none|
|» workspace|body|[WorkspaceDto](#schemaworkspacedto)|true|none|
|» auth|body|[AuthDto](#schemaauthdto)|true|none|

<h1 id="novu-api-channel-endpoints">Channel Endpoints</h1>

## List all channel endpoints

<a id="opIdChannelEndpointsController_listChannelEndpoints"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/channel-endpoints \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /v1/channel-endpoints`

List all channel endpoints for a resource based on query filters.

<h3 id="list-all-channel-endpoints-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|after|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the starting point after which to fetch results.|
|before|query|string|false|Cursor for pagination indicating the ending point before which to fetch results.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items to return (max 100)|
|orderDirection|query|string|false|Direction of sorting|
|orderBy|query|string|false|Field to order by|
|includeCursor|query|boolean|false|Include cursor item in response|
|subscriberId|query|string|false|The subscriber ID to filter results by|
|contextKeys|query|[string]|false|Filter by exact context keys, order insensitive (format: "type:id")|
|channel|query|string|false|Channel type to filter results.|
|providerId|query|[ProvidersIdEnum](#schemaprovidersidenum)|false|Filter by provider identifier (e.g., sendgrid, twilio, slack, etc.).|
|integrationIdentifier|query|string|false|Integration identifier to filter results.|
|connectionIdentifier|query|string|false|Connection identifier to filter results.|

## Create a channel endpoint

<a id="opIdChannelEndpointsController_createChannelEndpoint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/channel-endpoints \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "identifier": "slack-channel-user123-abc4",
    "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
    "createSubscriberIfMissing": false,
    "context": {
      "property1": "org-acme",
      "property2": "org-acme"
    },
    "integrationIdentifier": "slack-prod",
    "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
    "type": "slack_channel",
    "endpoint": {
      "channelId": "C123456789"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /v1/channel-endpoints`

## Update a channel endpoint

<a id="opIdChannelEndpointsController_updateChannelEndpoint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.novu.co/v1/channel-endpoints/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "endpoint": {
      "channelId": "C123456789"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/channel-endpoints/{identifier}`

Update an existing channel endpoint by its unique identifier.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "endpoint": {
    "channelId": "C123456789"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-channel-endpoint-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|identifier|path|string|true|The unique identifier of the channel endpoint|
|body|body|[UpdateChannelEndpointRequestDto](#schemaupdatechannelendpointrequestdto)|true|none|
|» endpoint|body|[SlackChannelEndpointDto](#schemaslackchannelendpointdto) \| [SlackUserEndpointDto](#schemaslackuserendpointdto) \| [WebhookEndpointDto](#schemawebhookendpointdto) \| [PhoneEndpointDto](#schemaphoneendpointdto) \| [WebexRoomEndpointDto](#schemawebexroomendpointdto) \| [WebexPersonEndpointDto](#schemawebexpersonendpointdto) \| [ToolWebhookEndpointDto](#schematoolwebhookendpointdto)|true|Updated endpoint data. The structure must match the existing channel endpoint type.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SlackChannelEndpointDto](#schemaslackchannelendpointdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[SlackUserEndpointDto](#schemaslackuserendpointdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[WebhookEndpointDto](#schemawebhookendpointdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[PhoneEndpointDto](#schemaphoneendpointdto)|false|none|

|» » *oneOf*|body|[WebexPersonEndpointDto](#schemawebexpersonendpointdto)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ToolWebhookEndpointDto](#schematoolwebhookendpointdto)|false|none|

<a id="tocStriggereventrequestdto"></a>
<a id="tocstriggereventrequestdto"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "workflow_identifier",
  "payload": {
    "comment_id": "string",
    "post": {
      "text": "string"
    }
  },
  "bridgeUrl": "https://your-tunnel.novu.co/api/novu",
  "overrides": {
    "fcm": {
      "data": {
        "key": "value"
      }
    }
  },
  "agentId": "support-agent",
  "to": [
    {
      "firstName": "John",
      "lastName": "Doe",
      "email": "john.doe@example.com",
      "phone": "+1234567890",
      "avatar": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
      "locale": "en-US",
      "timezone": "America/New_York",
      "data": {},
      "subscriberId": "string",
      "channels": [
        {
          "providerId": "slack",
          "integrationIdentifier": "string",
          "credentials": {
            "webhookUrl": "string",
            "deviceTokens": [
              "string"
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "transactionId": "string",
  "actor": "string",
  "tenant": "string",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The trigger identifier of the workflow you wish to send. This identifier can be found on the workflow page.|
|payload|object|false|none|The payload object is used to pass additional custom information that could be <br>    used to render the workflow, or perform routing rules based on it. <br>      This data will also be available when fetching the notifications feed from the API to display certain parts of the UI.|
|bridgeUrl|string|false|none|Optional Bridge Endpoint URL used to route this trigger to a specific Bridge application. Useful during local development when multiple engineers share an organization: set this to your personal tunnel URL from `npx novu@latest dev` (for example via NOVU_BRIDGE_URL) so app-fired triggers hit your machine instead of the environment's synced Bridge URL. Must be a publicly reachable https URL — private or localhost addresses are rejected.|
|overrides|object|false|none|This could be used to override provider specific configurations|
|agentId|string \| null|false|none|Override the workflow-assigned agent for this trigger using the public agent identifier. Omit to use the workflow default; pass null to disable agent routing for this execution.|
|to|[[SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto) \| [TopicPayloadDto](#schematopicpayloaddto) \| string] \| string \| [SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto) \| [TopicPayloadDto](#schematopicpayloaddto)|true|none|The recipients list of people who will receive the notification. Maximum number of recipients can be 100.|
|transactionId|string|false|none|A unique identifier for deduplication. If the same **transactionId** is sent again, <br>      the trigger is ignored. Useful to prevent duplicate notifications. The retention period depends on your billing tier.|
|actor|string \| [SubscriberPayloadDto](#schemasubscriberpayloaddto)|false|none|It is used to display the Avatar of the provided actor's subscriber id or actor object.<br>    If a new actor object is provided, we will create a new subscriber in our system|

<h2 id="tocS_AgentBehaviorDto">AgentBehaviorDto</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaagentbehaviordto"></a>
<a id="schema_AgentBehaviorDto"></a>
<a id="tocSagentbehaviordto"></a>
<a id="tocsagentbehaviordto"></a>

```json
{
  "acknowledgeOnReceived": true,
  "reactionOnResolved": "check",
  "subscriberAccess": "open",
  "replyPolicy": "auto_reply"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acknowledgeOnReceived|boolean|false|none|Acknowledge incoming messages. On platforms that support a native typing indicator (e.g. Slack, WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, Telegram), shows a "Typing…" indicator while the agent processes the message. On platforms that do not (e.g. Email), reacts with an "eyes" emoji to the first inbound message in a thread. Default: true|
|reactionOnResolved|object \| null|false|none|Cross-platform emoji name for resolved conversations (e.g. "check", "star"). Set to null to disable. Default: "check"|
|subscriberAccess|string|false|none|Controls whether the agent accepts inbound messages from senders not yet linked to a subscriber, across all channels. "open" on managed agents auto-creates a lightweight subscriber so the agent can reply; on custom-code / self-hosted agents, the turn is forwarded to the bridge with a null subscriber. "restricted" rejects unknown senders with a managed denial reply (any runtime). Optional on update (partial PATCH). Persisted agents always have a value — managed create defaults to "open"; self-hosted create defaults to "restricted".|
|replyPolicy|string|false|none|How the agent replies in shared rooms. "mention_only" requires an @mention in every shared room. "auto_reply" replies to unmentioned follow-ups in a nested Slack or Teams thread after the agent has joined. "smart" behaves like auto_reply while one person is talking to the agent in a thread, then requires an @mention there once someone else or another agent joins, or the incumbent @mentions another teammate. Create persists "smart". An omitted field on existing agents still means "auto_reply". DMs always reply without a mention. Optional on update (partial PATCH).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|subscriberAccess|open|
|subscriberAccess|restricted|
|replyPolicy|mention_only|
|replyPolicy|auto_reply|
|replyPolicy|smart|

```json
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|_id|string|true|none|Agent–integration link document id.|
|_agentId|string|true|none|none|
|integration|[AgentIntegrationResponseIntegrationDto](#schemaagentintegrationresponseintegrationdto)|true|none|none|
|_environmentId|string|true|none|none|
|_organizationId|string|true|none|none|
|connectedAt|object \| null|false|none|Set when the agent–integration link received its first inbound webhook delivery.|
|createdAt|string|true|none|none|
|updatedAt|string|true|none|none|
|exceedsPlanLimit|boolean|false|none|Cloud only. `true` when this channel type (provider) falls outside the organization plan active-channel limit (by connection order). Active channels are counted per channel type, so multiple integrations of the same provider (e.g. several Slack workspaces) count as a single active channel. Over-limit channels keep their configuration but the agent will not respond on them until the plan is upgraded or older channel types are disconnected.|
|hasChannelEndpoints|boolean|false|none|`true` when at least one person has linked their chat on this integration (it has a channel endpoint), so the agent has someone to reach there. Only returned by the list, and only when true. Email has no channel endpoints, so it never carries the flag.|

```json
        "url": "https://example.com/files/report.pdf"
      }
    ]
  },
  "toolApprovalRequest": {
    "approvalId": "apr_01HZX",
    "toolCallId": "call_refund_1",
    "name": "issue_refund",
    "input": {
      "orderId": "ORD-42",
      "amountCents": 2500
    },
    "approveActionId": "tool-approval:approve:apr_01HZX",
    "denyActionId": "tool-approval:deny:apr_01HZX",
    "mcpServerName": "GitHub",
    "to": {},
    "from": "string",
    "ttlSeconds": 0
  },
  "edit": {
    "messageId": "1712345678.123456",
    "content": {
      "markdown": "**Report ready.** Your weekly summary is attached.",
      "files": [
        {
          "filename": "report.pdf",
          "mimeType": "application/pdf",
          "data": "JVBERi0xLjQK...",
          "url": "https://example.com/files/report.pdf"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "resolve": {
    "summary": "Answered billing question about invoice INV-42."
  },
  "signals": [
    {
      "type": "metadata",
      "action": "set",
      "key": "crm:ticketId",
      "value": "TCK-1001"
    }
  ],
  "toolResults": [
    {
      "toolCallId": "call_abc123",
      "toolName": "lookup_order",
      "output": {},
      "preview": "Order ORD-42 is shipped"
    }
  ],
  "addReactions": [
    {
      "messageId": "1712345678.123456",
      "emojiName": "white_check_mark"
    }
  ],
  "deleteMessages": [
    {
      "messageId": "1712345678.123456"
    }
  ],
  "typing": {
    "status": "Looking up your order…"
  },
  "error": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|conversationId|string|true|none|Conversation id to reply into. Obtained from the inbound agent event / bridge payload.|
|integrationIdentifier|string|true|none|Channel integration identifier linked to the agent for this conversation (e.g. `slack-support`).|
|reply|[MarkdownReplyContentDto](#schemamarkdownreplycontentdto) \| [CardReplyContentDto](#schemacardreplycontentdto) \| [ToolApprovalCardReplyContentDto](#schematoolapprovalcardreplycontentdto)|false|none|Outbound message content. Exactly one of `markdown`, `card`, or `toolApprovalCard`. Optional `files` attach to the message. Cannot be combined with `edit`.|
|toolApprovalRequest|object|false|none|Tool-lifecycle ledger row for a gated tool call. Pair with `reply.toolApprovalCard` (or another reply shape) to deliver the approval UI.|
|edit|object|false|none|In-place edit of a previously posted agent message. Cannot be combined with reply, resolve, signals, toolResults, toolApprovalRequest, addReactions, or deleteMessages.|
|resolve|object|false|none|Mark the conversation resolved. May be combined with a final `reply`.|
|signals|[[MetadataSetSignalDto](#schemametadatasetsignaldto) \| [MetadataDeleteSignalDto](#schemametadatadeletesignaldto) \| [MetadataClearSignalDto](#schemametadataclearsignaldto) \| [TriggerSignalDto](#schematriggersignaldto) \| [HumanSignalDto](#schemahumansignaldto)]|false|none|Side-effect signals executed during this turn: conversation metadata mutations, Novu workflow triggers, or human-in-the-loop interactions.|
|toolResults|[[ToolResultDto](#schematoolresultdto)]|false|none|Tool-call outcomes to persist in conversation history (typically before the assistant reply).|
|addReactions|[[AddReactionPayloadDto](#schemaaddreactionpayloaddto)]|false|none|Emoji reactions to add to existing platform messages.|
|deleteMessages|[[DeleteMessagePayloadDto](#schemadeletemessagepayloaddto)]|false|none|Delete previously posted platform messages. Removes the rendered message only — history is preserved.|
|typing|string \| [TypingStatusDto](#schematypingstatusdto)|false|none|Per-turn typing/status control. Pass `{ status?: string }` to set/update the status (omit `status` for "Thinking…"), or `"stop"` to clear it. Best-effort per platform.|
|error|boolean|false|none|Bridge reports that the customer runtime failed this turn. Cannot be combined with other actions. Novu delivers generic user-facing error copy.|

|identifier|string|true|none|A unique string identifier for the integration, often used for API calls or internal references.|
|providerId|string|true|none|The identifier for the provider of the integration (e.g., "mailgun", "twilio").|

|kind|string|false|none|Distinguishes delivery integrations from agent-runtime integrations. Defaults to "delivery". Agent integrations do not have a channel.|
|credentials|object|false|none|The decrypted credentials required for the integration to function (e.g. provider API keys, signing secrets). Only returned to dashboard/session-token callers; API-key authenticated callers receive the integration metadata without this field to avoid amplifying API-key leaks into provider-credential leaks.|
|configurations|object|false|none|The configurations required for enabling the additional configurations of the integration.|
|active|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the integration is currently active. An active integration will process events and messages.|
|deleted|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the integration has been marked as deleted (soft delete).|
|deletedAt|string|false|none|The timestamp indicating when the integration was deleted. This is set when the integration is soft deleted.|
|deletedBy|string|false|none|The identifier of the user who performed the deletion of this integration. Useful for audit trails.|
|primary|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether this integration is marked as primary. A primary integration is often the default choice for processing.|
|conditions|[[StepFilterDto](#schemastepfilterdto)]|false|none|**Deprecated.** Legacy StepFilter conditions. Ignored when `rules` is also set.|
|rules|object \| null|false|none|JSONLogic used at send time to select this integration. Takes precedence over `conditions`.|

<h2 id="tocS_GenerateChatOauthUrlRequestDto">GenerateChatOauthUrlRequestDto</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemageneratechatoauthurlrequestdto"></a>

```json
{
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "scope": [
    "chat:write",
    "chat:write.public",
    "channels:read",
    "groups:read",
    "users:read",
    "users:read.email",
    "incoming-webhook"
  ],
  "userScope": [
    "identity.basic"
  ],
  "mode": "link_user",
  "connectionMode": "shared",
  "autoLinkUser": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|string|false|none|The subscriber ID to link the channel connection to. For Slack: Required for incoming webhook endpoints, optional for workspace connections. For MS Teams: Optional. Admin consent is tenant-wide and can be associated with a subscriber for organizational purposes.|
|integrationIdentifier|string|true|none|Integration identifier|
|connectionIdentifier|string|false|none|Identifier of the channel connection that will be created. It is generated automatically if not provided.|
|context|object|false|none|none|
|scope|[string]|false|none|**Slack only**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. These define the permissions your Slack integration will have. If not specified, default scopes will be used: chat:write, chat:write.public, channels:read, groups:read, users:read, users:read.email. **Webex**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. Defaults to: spark:messages_write, spark:rooms_read, spark:people_read, spark:memberships_read, spark:kms. **MS Teams**: This parameter is ignored. MS Teams uses admin consent with pre-configured permissions in Azure AD. Note: The generated OAuth URL expires after 5 minutes.|
|userScope|[string]|false|none|**Slack only, link_user mode**: User-level OAuth scopes to request during authorization. Used when mode is "link_user" to identify the Slack user via "Sign in with Slack". If not specified, defaults to: identity.basic.|
|mode|string|false|none|OAuth flow mode. Use "connect" (default) to create a workspace channel connection, or "link_user" to identify the subscriber's Slack user ID without creating a connection.|
|connectionMode|string|false|none|Connection mode that determines how the channel connection is scoped. Use "subscriber" (default) to associate the connection with a specific subscriber. Use "shared" to associate the connection with a context instead of a subscriber — subscriberId will not be stored on the connection.|
|autoLinkUser|boolean|false|none|When true, after the workspace/tenant connection is created the OAuth flow also links the subscriber who clicked "Connect" as a personal endpoint. For Slack, this uses the authed_user.id already returned by oauth.v2.access — no extra redirect. For Webex, this uses the authenticated Webex person returned by people/me — no extra redirect. For MS Teams, this triggers a second OAuth redirect for delegated user-identity consent. Defaults to false when omitted; the SlackConnectButton and MsTeamsConnectButton SDK components default this to true.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|mode|connect|
|mode|link_user|
|connectionMode|subscriber|
|connectionMode|shared|

<h2 id="tocS_GenerateConnectOauthUrlRequestDto">GenerateConnectOauthUrlRequestDto</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagenerateconnectoauthurlrequestdto"></a>
<a id="schema_GenerateConnectOauthUrlRequestDto"></a>
<a id="tocSgenerateconnectoauthurlrequestdto"></a>
<a id="tocsgenerateconnectoauthurlrequestdto"></a>

```json
{
  "subscriberId": "subscriber-123",
  "integrationIdentifier": "string",
  "connectionIdentifier": "slack-connection-abc123",
  "context": {
    "property1": "org-acme",
    "property2": "org-acme"
  },
  "contextHash": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  "scope": [
    "chat:write",
    "chat:write.public",
    "channels:read"
  ],
  "connectionMode": "shared",
  "autoLinkUser": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|string|false|none|The subscriber ID to associate with the channel connection. For Slack: optional for workspace connections (required only for incoming-webhook scope). For Webex: optional for workspace connections. For MS Teams: optional. Admin consent is tenant-wide.|
|integrationIdentifier|string|true|none|Integration identifier|
|connectionIdentifier|string|false|none|Identifier of the channel connection that will be created. Generated automatically if not provided.|
|context|object|false|none|none|
|contextHash|string|false|none|HMAC-SHA256 of the canonicalized `context`, signed with the tenant environment secret key (the same "Inbox with context" signing scheme). Required when the integration has HMAC validation enabled and the session did not already HMAC-verify the context. Establishes that the context/tenant binding was minted by an authenticated backend rather than forged in the browser.|
|scope|[string]|false|none|**Slack only**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. If not specified, default scopes will be used: chat:write, chat:write.public, channels:read, groups:read, users:read, users:read.email. **Webex**: OAuth scopes to request during authorization. Defaults to: spark:messages_write, spark:rooms_read, spark:people_read, spark:memberships_read, spark:kms. **MS Teams**: ignored — uses admin consent with pre-configured Azure AD permissions.|
|connectionMode|string|false|none|Connection mode that determines how the channel connection is scoped. "subscriber" (default) associates the connection with a specific subscriber. "shared" associates the connection with a context instead of a subscriber.|
|autoLinkUser|boolean|false|none|When true (default when connectionMode is "subscriber"), after the workspace/tenant connection is created the OAuth flow also links the subscriber who clicked "Connect" as a personal endpoint. For Slack, uses the authed_user.id returned by oauth.v2.access — no extra redirect. For Webex, uses the authenticated Webex person returned by people/me — no extra redirect. For MS Teams, triggers a second OAuth redirect for delegated user-identity consent. Set to false to only create the workspace connection without linking the individual user.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|connectionMode|subscriber|
|connectionMode|shared|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscriberId|string|true|none|The subscriber ID to link to their chat identity. Required — this operation always binds a specific subscriber to a user identity in the chat provider.|
|integrationIdentifier|string|true|none|Integration identifier|

|context|object|false|none|none|

Required when the integration has HMAC validation enabled and the session did not already HMAC-verify the context, so the per-user link carries a trustworthy subscriber/tenant binding.|
|userScope|[string]|false|none|**Slack only**: User-level OAuth scopes for "Sign in with Slack". Defaults to: identity.basic. **Webex**: Optional Webex scopes for people/me; defaults to spark:people_read. **MS Teams**: ignored — uses delegated OpenID scopes (openid, profile, User.Read).|

|channel|object|true|none|The channel through which the notification is sent.|

|seen|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the notification has been seen by the subscriber.|
|archived|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the notification has been archived by the subscriber.|

|cta|object|true|none|Call-to-action information associated with the notification.|
|status|string|true|none|Current status of the notification.|
|payload|object|false|none|The payload that was used to send the notification trigger.|
|data|object \| null|false|none|The data sent with the notification.|

|errorId|string|false|none|Error ID if the message has an error|
|errorText|string|false|none|Error text if the message has an error|
|payload|object|false|none|The payload that was used to send the notification trigger|
|overrides|object|false|none|Provider specific overrides used when triggering the notification|
|contextKeys|[string]|false|none|Context (single or multi) in which the message was sent|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|controls|object|true|none|Controls metadata for the step|
|controlValues|object|false|none|Control values for the step (alias for controls.values)|
|providerOverrides|object \| null|false|none|Per-provider content overrides keyed by providerId. Stored separately from controlValues and merged over the default body at send time. Keys are ChatProviderIdEnum / ToolProviderIdEnum values (e.g. `slack`, `whatsapp-business`, `pagerduty`).|
|integrationOverrides|object \| null|false|none|Per-integration content overrides keyed by providerId, then by integration identifier. Each entry is merged over the matching providerOverrides entry, only for sends through that integration. Trigger-time overrides still take precedence. Entries whose integration does not exist in the environment are kept but not applied.|
|variables|object|true|none|JSON Schema for variables, follows the JSON Schema standard|
|stepId|string|true|none|Unique identifier of the step|
|_id|string|true|none|Database identifier of the step|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the step|
|slug|string|true|none|Slug of the step|
|type|object|true|none|Type of the step|
|origin|object|true|none|Origin of the step|
|workflowId|string|true|none|Workflow identifier|
|workflowDatabaseId|string|true|none|Workflow database identifier|
|issues|object|false|none|Issues associated with the step|
|stepResolverHash|string|false|none|Hash identifying the deployed Cloudflare Worker for this step|

<h2 id="tocS_EmailControlDto">EmailControlDto</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaemailcontroldto"></a>

<a id="tocSemailcontroldto"></a>
<a id="tocsemailcontroldto"></a>

```json
{
  "skip": {
    "and": [
      {
        "==": [
          {
            "var": "payload.tier"
          },
          "pro"
        ]
      },
      {
        "==": [
          {
            "var": "subscriber.data.role"
          },
          "admin"
        ]
      },
      {
        ">": [
          {
            "var": "payload.amount"
          },
          "4"
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "subject": "string",
  "body": "",
  "editorType": "block",
  "disableOutputSanitization": false,
  "layoutId": "string",
  "from": {
    "email": "string",
    "name": "string"
  },
  "useProviderDefaults": true,
  "replyTo": "string",
  "preheader": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|skip|object|false|none|JSONLogic filter conditions for conditionally skipping the step execution. Supports complex logical operations with AND, OR, and comparison operators. See https://jsonlogic.com/ for full typing reference.|
|subject|string|true|none|Subject of the email.|
|body|string|true|none|Body content of the email, either a valid Maily JSON object, or html string.|
|editorType|string|false|none|Type of editor to use for the body.|
|disableOutputSanitization|boolean|false|none|Disable sanitization of the output.|
|layoutId|string \| null|false|none|Layout ID to use for the email. Null means no layout, undefined means default layout.|
|from|object|false|none|Sender name and email overrides for this step.|
|useProviderDefaults|boolean|false|none|When true, sender name/email use the primary email integration defaults and skip workflow agent defaults.|
|replyTo|string|false|none|Step-level Reply-To override. When unset, inherits the workflow agent reply-to.|
|preheader|string|false|none|One-line inbox preview text shown next to the subject.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|editorType|block|
|editorType|html|

```json
    "redirect": {
      "url": "string",
      "target": "_self"
    }
```

```json
  "data": {}
}
```

|body|string|false|none|Content/body of the in-app message. Required if subject is empty.|
|subject|string|false|none|Subject/title of the in-app message. Required if body is empty.|
|avatar|string|false|none|URL for an avatar image. Must be a valid URL or start with / or {{ variable }}.|
|primaryAction|object|false|none|Primary action button details.|
|secondaryAction|object|false|none|Secondary action button details.|
|redirect|object|false|none|Redirection URL configuration for the main content click (if no actions defined/clicked)..|
|disableOutputSanitization|boolean|false|none|Disable sanitization of the output.|
|data|object|false|none|Additional data payload for the step.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filename|string|true|none|File name of the attachment|
|contentType|string|true|none|MIME type of the attachment|
|size|number|true|none|File size in bytes|
|url|string|false|none|Presigned download URL. Absent on self-hosted deployments without S3, where `content` carries the bytes instead.|
|expiresAt|string(date-time)|false|none|ISO timestamp when `url` stops being valid. Present when Novu signed the URL for webhook delivery.|
|content|object \| null|false|none|Deprecated, use `url`. Raw content in the legacy `{ type: "Buffer", data: number[] }` format, or `null` when rehydration failed.|
|contentBytes|number|false|none|Deprecated, use `size`|
